item.hextale.unstable_hextech.tooltip: Raw hextech that bursts if it falls from a height or is caught in an explosion. Thrown, it breaks into Hextech Dust.
item.hextale.grapple_gauntlet.hint: Throws a claw on a cord of light that hooks onto a block. Swing on the cord, reel it in or let it out.
item.hextale.grapple_gauntlet.controls: (Hold right click: throw and hang on; release: let go; jump: reel in; sneak: let out)
jei.hextale.info.grapple_gauntlet: Throws a claw on a cord of light that grips a block up to 32 blocks away. Let go at the top of a swing to fly on. (Hold right click: hang on, jump: reel in, sneak: let out)
grapple_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Let go of the cord while hanging and your next landing within 10 seconds deals no fall damage.
grapple_rune.hextale.gravity.desc: The claw also hits mobs and yanks them toward you.
grapple_rune.hextale.blades.desc: The claw also hits mobs and damages them.
book.hextale.quest.grapple_rune.note: A Grapple Gauntlet holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_grapple: Put the Grapple Gauntlet in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a gauntlet
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the gauntlet holds three runes
quest.hextale.grapple_gauntlet.desc: The gauntlet shoots a cord of light with a claw at the end that catches on stone. It works like a rope: I drop until it catches me, then I swing. (Hold right click: hang on, jump: reel in, sneak: let out)
block.hextale.disintegrator.hint: Breaks down any item put or thrown into it into Unknown Essence and pours it into the jar or pipe below. (Shift + right click: take back what is still whole)
jei.hextale.info.disintegrator: Breaks dropped items down into unknown essence that flows into a jar or pipe below. Each item makes the land sicker.
disintegrator_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Each item gives more unknown essence.
disintegrator_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Sometimes an item gives a little experience.
disintegrator_rune.hextale.hush.desc: Breaking items down makes the land less sick.
book.hextale.quest.disintegrator_rune.no: A Disintegrator holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_disintegra: Put the Disintegrator in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a disintegrator
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the bowl holds three runes
quest.hextale.disintegrator.desc: A bowl that breaks anything thrown into it down into unknown essence. The essence runs out below into a jar or a pipe. It clears junk fast, but the land around it suffers.
block.hextale.world_anchor.hint: Keeps its chunk loaded while you are far away. It pays with Earth Essence from jars nearby and stops when they run dry.
block.hextale.world_anchor.status: Holds %s chunks, eats %s mB of earth essence a minute
block.hextale.world_anchor.asleep: Asleep: no earth essence in the jars around it
jei.hextale.info.world_anchor: Keeps its chunk loaded while you are away: furnaces burn, crops grow. Without earth essence in nearby jars it sleeps. (Right click with an empty hand: what it holds)
world_anchor_rune.hextale.shift.desc: Also keeps the chunks around its own loaded.
world_anchor_rune.hextale.haste.desc: The held chunks get extra random ticks, so crops grow and blocks change faster.
world_anchor_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Every few seconds, some plants in the held chunks grow a little.
world_anchor_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a minute of holding costs no earth essence.
book.hextale.quest.world_anchor_rune.not: A World Anchor holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_world_anch: Put the World Anchor in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a world anchor
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the anchor holds three runes
quest.hextale.world_anchor.desc: The World Anchor keeps its chunk loaded while I am far away, so furnaces keep burning and farms keep growing. It runs on earth essence from the jars nearby.
item.hextale.spawner_cage.hint: Picks up a monster spawner so it can be set down somewhere else. The cage is used up once the spawner is placed.
item.hextale.spawner_cage.full_hint: Something in it is still breathing out monsters. Where should it live now?
item.hextale.spawner_cage.controls: (Right click a spawner: pick it up; right click a block: place it)
jei.hextale.info.spawner_cage: Folds a monster spawner into itself and sets it down elsewhere, then is used up. (Right click a spawner: take. Right click a block: place)
quest.hextale.spawner_cage.desc: The Spawner Cage folds a monster spawner into an item and sets it down somewhere else. Each cage burns out after a single move.
item.hextale.soul_flask.too_heavy: It holds too much to fit in the flask
item.hextale.soul_flask.hint: Holds one creature with its saddle, gear and name and lets it out where you choose. Players and bosses do not fit.
item.hextale.soul_flask.controls: (Right click a creature: catch it; right click a block: let it out)
jei.hextale.info.soul_flask: Carries a creature with everything it wears and lets it out elsewhere. Players, bosses and others' pets do not fit. (Right click a creature: take in. Right click a block: let out)
soul_rune.hextale.healing.desc: A creature comes out of the flask at full health.
soul_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A baby animal comes out of the flask fully grown.
soul_rune.hextale.slumber.desc: A hostile mob comes out of the flask asleep and cannot attack for a while.
book.hextale.quest.soul_rune.note: A Soul Flask holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_soul: Put an empty Soul Flask in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a soul flask
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the flask holds three runes
quest.hextale.soul_flask.desc: The Soul Flask folds a living creature into the glass, saddle and name included, and lets it out where I want. Players and dragon-sized creatures do not fit.
item.hextale.recall_charm.hint: Takes you back to where you stood a few seconds ago in the same dimension, wounds and all. Each use spends one winding.
item.hextale.recall_charm.controls: (Right click: go back; right click a jar: wind it with Rift Essence)
item.hextale.recall_charm.nowhere: The charm has nowhere to take you back to
item.hextale.recall_charm.unwound: The charm has run down: wind it at a jar of rift essence
item.hextale.recall_charm.no_rift: No rift essence in this jar
jei.hextale.info.recall_charm: Takes you back to where you stood 5 seconds ago. Each use spends a winding, and rift essence from a jar winds it up. (Right click: go back. Right click a jar: wind)
recall_rune.hextale.shift.desc: Takes you back to where you were more seconds ago.
recall_rune.hextale.haste.desc: The charm needs less rest between recalls.
recall_rune.hextale.mending.desc: A recall heals you a little.
recall_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: A recall puts out fire on you and gives Fire Resistance for a few seconds.
recall_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a recall uses no winding.
book.hextale.quest.recall_rune.note: A Recall Charm holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_recall: Put the Recall Charm in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a recall charm
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the charm holds three runes
quest.hextale.recall_charm.desc: The Recall Charm puts me back where I stood a few seconds ago, but wounds stay. Each return spends a winding, and rift essence winds it again. It helps at a cliff edge or in lava.
block.hextale.rift_gate.hint: Anything entering the ring, fluids included, comes out of the linked gate. Crossings use Rift Essence from nearby jars. (Right click with Unstable Hextech: make a link crystal)
block.hextale.rift_gate.same: The crystal already remembers this gate
block.hextale.rift_gate.lost: The gate it remembered is gone; now it remembers this one
block.hextale.rift_gate.status.none: Not linked (right click with a raw hextech orb)
block.hextale.rift_gate.dry: The gate is dry: no rift essence in the jars beside it
item.hextale.rift_link_crystal.hint: Remembers the gate it was made at. Right click another Lesser Rift Gate with it to link the two.
jei.hextale.info.rift_gate: Linked gates carry players, mobs, items and fluids, even across dimensions, for rift essence from nearby jars. (Right click a gate with Unstable Hextech, then the other gate with the crystal)
jei.hextale.info.rift_link_crystal: Remembers one rift gate. Use it on another gate to link the two, and the crystal is used up. (Right click a gate)
quest.hextale.rift_gate.desc: Two Rift Gates open onto each other however far apart they are. A raw hextech orb pressed to one and then the other links them. Crossing costs rift essence at the gate I leave by.
block.hextale.impulse_plate.hint: Throws whoever steps on it along its arrow. With a target set, it throws to that spot and the landing is soft. (Right click with an empty hand, then right click the target: set the target)
block.hextale.impulse_plate.aim: Right click the block it should throw to (right click the plate again to clear)
block.hextale.impulse_plate.too_far: Too far for this plate: up to %s blocks
jei.hextale.info.impulse_plate: Throws whatever steps on it along its arrow. Given a target block, it lands them right there without fall damage. (Right click with an empty hand, then the target. While aiming, the plate: clear)
impulse_rune.hextale.shift.desc: Throws higher, and the target can be set farther away.
impulse_rune.hextale.motor.desc: Without a target it throws farther forward. With a target the flight is quicker.
impulse_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Even without a target, whoever it throws takes no fall damage on landing.
impulse_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Whoever it throws gets Speed for a while.
impulse_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: Hostile mobs that step on the plate are thrown back and high up, with no soft landing.
book.hextale.quest.impulse_rune.note: An Impulse Plate holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_impulse: Put the Impulse Plate in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to an impulse plate
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the plate holds three runes
quest.hextale.impulse_plate.desc: The levitation rune, wound tight and released at once, can throw like a spring. Whatever steps on the plate flies along its arrow, or to a spot I show it, and lands softly. (Right click with an empty hand, then right click the spot)
block.hextale.null_lantern.hint: Hostile mobs do not spawn naturally near the lantern.
jei.hextale.info.null_lantern: Hostile mobs do not spawn naturally within 24 blocks. Spawners, spawn eggs and mobs walking in are not affected.
null_rune.hextale.shift.desc: Mobs do not spawn over a larger distance from the lantern.
null_rune.hextale.hush.desc: Phantoms do not spawn for players within the lantern's range.
null_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: Hostile mobs within the lantern's range take a little damage every few seconds.
null_rune.hextale.silence.desc: Sounds within the lantern's range are quieter. From 3 stars, no vibration inside reaches sculk.
book.hextale.quest.null_lantern_rune.not: A Null Lantern holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_null_lante: Put the Null Lantern in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a null lantern
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the lantern holds three runes
quest.hextale.null_lantern.desc: The Null Lantern is nullstone around Unstable Hextech. Hostile mobs do not spawn near it on their own. Spawners still work, and mobs from outside can walk in.
block.hextale.floating_stone.hint: A block that can be placed in midair. (Right click with no block in sight: place it a few blocks ahead)
jei.hextale.info.floating_stone: A building block placed in mid-air: aimed at nothing, it appears 3 blocks in front of you. (Right click into the air)
quest.hextale.floating_stone.desc: If the plate can lift what stands on it, a stone might hold itself up. Placed into the air, Floating Stone settles a few blocks ahead of me and stays there. (Right click into the air)
block.hextale.ward_glass.hint: Players cannot pass through it. Mobs and dropped items can.
block.hextale.veil_glass.hint: Players walk through it freely. Mobs cannot get through.
jei.hextale.info.ward_glass: Stops players and lets creatures and dropped items pass through. Mobs find their paths through it.
jei.hextale.info.veil_glass: Lets players pass through and stops creatures. Projectiles hit it like normal glass, and mobs walk around it.
quest.hextale.sieve_glass.desc: Hextech Dust in glass draws a barrier rune that lets only some things through. Ward Glass lets creatures and items pass but stops me. Veil Glass works the other way round.
block.hextale.levitation_plate.hint: Lifts whatever stands on it up a column and keeps it floating at the top. (Sneak: sink down)
jei.hextale.info.levitation_plate: Lifts whatever stands above it up to 6 blocks, or to the first solid block, and holds it there without fall damage. (Sneak: sink down)
plate_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Players and mobs that leave the column get Slow Falling for a few seconds.
plate_rune.hextale.cache.desc: Items at the top of the column go into the chest, barrel or other container above it.
plate_rune.hextale.slumber.desc: Mobs in the column fall asleep and cannot attack. They wake up a few seconds after leaving it.
book.hextale.quest.plate_rune.note: A Levitation Plate holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_plate: Put the Levitation Plate in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a levitation plate
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the plate holds three runes
quest.hextale.levitation_plate.desc: A raw orb floats a little above my palm when I hold it still. Set flat in brass on a stone plate, it lifts whatever stands on it and holds it in the air. (Shift: sink down)
item.hextale.dust_charge.hint: Sticks where it lands and bursts a moment later. It breaks the stone around it and leaves everything else whole.
jei.hextale.info.dust_charge: Sticks where it lands and bursts, mining stone, ores, dirt and gravel about 2 blocks around like an iron pickaxe. (Right click: throw)
quest.hextale.dust_charge.desc: Hextech Dust packed tight in paper bursts in a bright flash. The charge sticks where it lands, and a moment later the stone around it breaks and drops like mined stone. (Right click: throw)
item.hextale.tuning_fork.hint: Rings louder and higher the closer hextech is in the ground. Tuned to a block, it searches for that block.
item.hextale.tuning_fork.controls: (Hold right click: listen; Shift + right click a block: tune to it; Shift + right click the air: reset)
fork_rune.hextale.insight.desc: Blocks it finds glow through walls for a while.
fork_rune.hextale.signal.desc: Finds several blocks at once, with a thread of light to each.
fork_rune.hextale.gemstone.desc: When not tuned to a block, it also finds ores within part of its range.
book.hextale.quest.fork_rune.note: A Tuning Fork holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_fork: Put the Tuning Fork in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a tuning fork
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the fork holds three runes
jei.hextale.info.tuning_fork: Rings higher and louder the nearer hextech is, and a thread of light points the way. Tuned to a block, it seeks it. (Hold right click: listen. Shift + right click a block: tune. Shift + right click the air: untune)
quest.hextale.tuning_fork.desc: A raw orb set between two brass prongs rings near hextech: the nearer it lies, the higher the sound. Struck against a block, the fork tunes to that block instead. (Hold right click: listen, Shift + right click a block: tune)
item.hextale.rune_scroll.known: You already know %s as well as this scroll can teach.
item.hextale.rune_scroll.unreadable: The signs on this scroll mean nothing to me. Not yet.
item.hextale.researchers_diary.unsigned: Empty pages. The first one to open it will make it theirs.
item.hextale.researchers_diary.foreign: This is %s's diary. You cannot read it.
hextale.configuration.title: HexTale
advancements.hextale.root.title: HexTale
advancements.hextale.root.description: Hextech has to be studied before it can be made.
advancements.hextale.born_of_storm.title: Born of the Storm
advancements.hextale.born_of_storm.descr: Lightning struck the amethyst and turned it into Unstable Hextech.
advancements.hextale.researchers_table.d: I have my own Research Table now, and the real research can begin.
advancements.hextale.first_rune.title: First Rune
advancements.hextale.first_rune.descript: I have learned my first rune. Now it can be burned into a tool or a device.
rune.hextale.fire_water.effect: Makes chemtech devices that work with steam and heat give more: an extra dose, an extra vial, faster pressure.
rune.hextale.fire_water.use: Mechanism: a steam drive that moves pistons without redstone.
rune.hextale.unknown.effect: This rune cannot be read yet.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.effect: Smelts what is mined or carried, as a furnace would. In a foundry, molten stone and sand may leave a little metal.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.use: Pickaxe: ore drops as ingots, sand as glass.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.hint: Heat aimed at ore gives ingots by itself.
rune.hextale.fire_air.effect: Hot flame from the jets that sets pursuing creatures on fire.
rune.hextale.fire_air.use: Gauntlets: a jet of fire 5 blocks long.
rune.hextale.fire_light.effect: Saves fuel and leaves lasting light. A burn sometimes costs nothing or lasts twice as long.
rune.hextale.fire_light.use: Mechanism: a lantern without fuel that lights the lanterns next to it.
rune.hextale.fire_light.hint: A flame that shines without wood, forever.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.effect: Burns away impurities, so a batch sometimes comes out completely clean.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.use: Sword: double damage to the undead, burns cobwebs.
rune.hextale.fire_life.effect: Sets creatures on fire at a touch.
rune.hextale.fire_life.use: Weapon: sets the target on fire on hit.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.effect: Melts worn metal gear back into whole ingots.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.use: Mechanism: a smelter that returns ingots from broken tools.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.effect: A fiery blast that hurts everything around it.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.use: Drill: blasts the 3×3 blocks around the point of impact.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.hint: All the heat at once. Dangerous.
rune.hextale.water_fire.effect: Protects from heat, so hot floors such as magma burn less.
rune.hextale.water_fire.use: Staff: puts out fires around, lava turns to obsidian.
rune.hextale.water_fire.hint: Water douses fire and cools lava.
rune.hextale.water_earth.effect: Works through soil and stone in bulk: whole ore veins, wider digging, stone ground down to gravel and sand.
rune.hextale.water_earth.use: Shovel: sand, gravel and dirt go in whole layers.
rune.hextale.water_air.effect: A thick fog that hides creatures from sight.
rune.hextale.water_air.use: Device: a cloud in which mobs lose their target.
rune.hextale.water_light.effect: Focuses light so that far things look near.
rune.hextale.water_light.use: Spyglass monocle: zooms in and highlights distant targets.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.effect: A whirlpool around the struck creature that drags the others nearby into it.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.use: Trap: mobs get stuck and slowly sink.
rune.hextale.water_life.effect: Heals players and creatures near the device, or the wearer after a blow.
rune.hextale.water_life.use: Staff: heals creatures and players around.
rune.hextale.water_life.hint: Water washes wounds. Turn it on the living.
rune.hextale.water_metal.effect: Eats into armour: blows hit harder and wear the armour down.
rune.hextale.water_metal.use: Weapon: ruins enemy armour, takes apart other people's mechanisms.
rune.hextale.water_spark.effect: A stored charge that shocks whoever attacks in close combat.
rune.hextale.water_spark.use: Mechanism: carries energy along a water channel.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.effect: Hardens against heat and wear: tools wear slower, kilns run hotter, flasks build up pressure slower.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.use: Any tool: loses durability half as fast, does not burn in lava.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.hint: Stone does not fear fire. Could a tool?
rune.hextale.earth_water.effect: Saves fuel and essence. Now and then a device or tool does its work for free.
rune.hextale.earth_water.use: Device: seals water and lava behind a wall.
rune.hextale.earth_water.hint: A wall of earth holds back even lava.
rune.hextale.earth_air.effect: Weight and pull: whole trees come down at once, creatures are yanked in, blows push the wearer back less.
rune.hextale.earth_air.use: Weapon: knocks down flying mobs, cancels knockback.
rune.hextale.earth_light.effect: Finds gems and ores in plain stone.
rune.hextale.earth_light.use: Pickaxe: a chance to get a gem or a hextech shard.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.effect: More loot, kept safe: extra drops, treasure in the soil, items sent straight into storage.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.use: Mechanism: a hidden chest that looks like any other block.
rune.hextale.earth_life.effect: Fertility: plants grow sooner, and harvests and ores give more.
rune.hextale.earth_life.use: Hoe: farmland never dries out, crops grow faster.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.effect: A wave through the ground that throws creatures in its path into the air.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.use: Mechanism: a lightning rod that protects machines from overload.
rune.hextale.air_fire.effect: Fans the fire: furnaces heat up faster, jets kick harder, a kill gives a burst of strength.
rune.hextale.air_fire.use: Mechanism: bellows, furnaces and smelters work twice as fast.
rune.hextale.air_water.effect: Lets the wearer walk on water.
rune.hextale.air_water.use: Mechanism: a pump that drains and moves water and lava.
rune.hextale.air_water.hint: Wind drives the waves. Could it drive water?
rune.hextale.air_earth.effect: Increases the reach and range of a device or tool.
rune.hextale.air_earth.use: Mechanism: a rune piston that moves up to 12 blocks.
rune.hextale.air_earth.hint: A gust moves dust. Why not a whole block?
rune.hextale.air_light.effect: A decoy of light. When the wearer is badly hurt, they vanish from sight and enemies chase the decoy.
rune.hextale.air_light.use: Device: an illusion that mobs attack.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.effect: Keeps work quiet: less harm to the land, no phantoms, bee nests that come down whole.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.use: Boots: neither mobs nor sculk can hear the player.
rune.hextale.air_life.effect: Air and soft landings: breath under water, slow falls, less damage from walls and the ground.
rune.hextale.air_life.use: Helmet: breathing underwater, an air bubble.
rune.hextale.air_metal.effect: Makes heavy things light: more carried at once, softer landings.
rune.hextale.air_metal.use: Mechanism: a lift and a crane for blocks and entities.
rune.hextale.air_spark.effect: Spinning air: quick strikes sweep all around, and jumps go higher.
rune.hextale.air_spark.use: Mechanism: a wind generator, stronger up high.
rune.hextale.air_spark.hint: Catch the wind and make it a charge.
rune.hextale.light_fire.effect: A hot beam that sets its targets on fire. What it kills drops cooked food.
rune.hextale.light_fire.use: Cutter: cuts blocks along a line, a long-range shot.
rune.hextale.light_water.effect: Cleans: less waste, more sickness drawn out of the land, poison and weakness washed off.
rune.hextale.light_water.use: Flask: removes poisons and negative effects.
rune.hextale.light_earth.effect: Shows what hides behind stone: ores and hostile creatures glow through walls.
rune.hextale.light_earth.use: Goggles: ores and caves show through walls.
rune.hextale.light_earth.hint: Light sent into stone shows what hides.
rune.hextale.light_air.use: Beacon marker: seen from afar, links devices together.
rune.hextale.light_shadow.effect: Light against the dark: night vision for you, harm and slowness for hostile creatures.
rune.hextale.light_shadow.use: Device: hostile mobs do not spawn around it.
rune.hextale.light_life.effect: Gold from living things: harvests and trees sometimes give golden produce.
rune.hextale.light_life.use: Lamp: crops grow underground and at night.
rune.hextale.light_metal.effect: Mobs killed with it sometimes drop their head.
rune.hextale.light_metal.use: Workbench: transfers runes onto tools and parts.
rune.hextale.light_spark.effect: Charges a device from daylight under the open sky.
rune.hextale.light_spark.use: Mechanism: a light panel that works by day.
rune.hextale.shadow_fire.effect: Draws off heat and pressure before they do harm.
rune.hextale.shadow_fire.use: Mechanism: cools overheated machines, puts furnaces out.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.effect: Soaks the essence of things into a jar nearby.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.use: Device: drains water and lava around it.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.use: Gauntlets: walk through a wall up to 2 blocks thick.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.effect: Hides whoever uses it from sight.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.hint: Shadow spilled into the air hides anyone.
rune.hextale.shadow_light.effect: Blows from behind deal more damage.
rune.hextale.shadow_light.use: Device: darkness around it, torches go out.
rune.hextale.shadow_life.effect: Drains life from the struck creature and gives some of it to you.
rune.hextale.shadow_life.use: Weapon: part of the damage heals the wielder.
rune.hextale.shadow_metal.effect: Wounds keep bleeding after the blow.
rune.hextale.shadow_metal.use: Weapon: enemy armour and tools break quickly.
rune.hextale.shadow_spark.effect: Muffles sounds around it. At full strength it also hides your steps from sculk.
rune.hextale.shadow_spark.use: Device: shuts down mechanisms around it.
rune.hextale.life_fire.use: Armour: immunity to fire and lava for a while.
rune.hextale.life_water.effect: Water for living things: moist soil and bigger yields from plants and creatures.
rune.hextale.life_earth.effect: Speeds up growth: saplings shoot up, felled trees are replanted, young creatures come out grown.
rune.hextale.life_earth.use: Staff: trees and crops grow at once.
rune.hextale.life_earth.hint: Life from the soil: sprouts in a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.life_air.effect: Spreads pollen: plants nearby grow, and leaves and harvests give more.
rune.hextale.life_air.use: Mechanism: plants seeds around by itself.
rune.hextale.life_light.effect: Gives more experience from the work of a device or tool.
rune.hextale.life_light.use: Arrows: highlight the target through walls.
rune.hextale.life_shadow.effect: Puts creatures to sleep for a while.
rune.hextale.life_shadow.use: Weapon: passive and weak mobs fall asleep.
rune.hextale.life_metal.effect: Mends: tools and clothes repair themselves, and wounds close a little.
rune.hextale.life_metal.hint: Life heals flesh. Could it mend steel?
rune.hextale.life_spark.effect: Starts again what has stopped working.
rune.hextale.metal_fire.use: Mechanism: a rune furnace and smelter.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.effect: Each blow digs out a wider area.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.hint: A chisel that bites into stone.
rune.hextale.metal_air.effect: Sharp blades of wind: more logs from trees, cuts on creatures.
rune.hextale.metal_air.use: Mechanism: a fan that blows entities and items away.
rune.hextale.metal_light.effect: Turns part of a blow back at the attacker.
rune.hextale.metal_shadow.effect: Locks things away and keeps them safe.
rune.hextale.metal_shadow.use: Device: chests and doors open only with a rune key.
rune.hextale.metal_life.effect: Makes metal move on its own.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.effect: Speeds up a device or tool: it works more often and moves faster.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.use: Mechanism: an engine for every machine.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.hint: In metal, a charge starts turning wheels.
rune.hextale.spark_fire.effect: Creatures killed with it burst and hurt the creatures around them.
rune.hextale.spark_water.effect: Electrifies water, so creatures standing in it get shocked.
rune.hextale.spark_water.use: Trap: damages everyone in the water.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.effect: Shatters the stone around and leaves the ore whole.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.use: Hammer: stuns everything around and crushes stone.
rune.hextale.spark_air.effect: Lightning that leaps from one target to the next.
rune.hextale.spark_air.hint: Lightning leaps from target to target.
rune.hextale.spark_light.effect: The first hit on an unhurt creature deals more damage.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.effect: Moves you behind the creature you look at, and your next blow hits harder.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.use: Gauntlets: a teleporting dash of 8 blocks.
rune.hextale.spark_life.effect: Speeds things up: faster hands, quicker steps, quicker work of devices.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.effect: Pulls loose items and experience toward you.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.use: Mechanism: collects dropped items and ore.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.hint: Lightning loves iron. Let it pull iron.
gui.hextale.research_table.need.diary: Put a Researcher's Diary into the diary slot.
gui.hextale.research_table.need.own_diar: This diary belongs to someone else. Bring your own.
gui.hextale.research_table.need.hextech: Put unstable hextech on the table: it lies in the middle of the parchment and goes into the research.
research.hextale.closed: %s cannot be researched yet: open its step in the book.
gui.hextale.research_table.loupe.hint: Hold and drag onto an item to study it
gui.hextale.research_table.choose: Choose what to research in the book
gui.hextale.research_table.slot.paper: Paper: every research starts on a fresh sheet
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.hint: Drawn from Essence Jars of %s concentrate around the table
block.hextale.brass_pipe.hint: Each side can be closed or made one-way. (Shift + right click a side with an empty hand: change it)
item.hextale.essence_flask.drink: Tastes of what it is made of. Fire, light, air - each leaves something behind for a minute.
item.hextale.essence_flask.mixture.hint: Everything at once, all mixed up. It needs pulling apart.
gui.hextale.alembic.cold: Needs heat below: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
gui.hextale.separator.mix: Mixture: comes in through the inlets, or from a bottle
gui.hextale.separator.extract: Concentrate of the chosen essence: leaves through the concentrate outlets
gui.hextale.separator.unknown.hint: Filters the dark unknown essence out of a mixture; the rest comes out clean
gui.hextale.alembic.out: Leaves through a pipe on any side, or into glass bottles
gui.hextale.separator.rest: The rest of the mixture: leaves through the rest outlets
gui.hextale.slot.bottles: Glass bottles: the essence is bottled into them
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.input: An item to boil into essence. An unstudied one gives dark unknown essence
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.output: A filled bottle of essence comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.pour: A bottle of mixture to pour in
gui.hextale.slot.separator.extract: The bottled concentrate comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.rest: The bottled rest of the mixture comes out here
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.no_storag: No storage: place an Essence Jar of %s concentrate within 5 blocks of the table
gui.hextale.separator.ports.hint: The separator seen from above, its front towards you. A side opens by itself when a pipe, a jar or an alembic is set beside it. Click a side to change what it does - or sneak-use that side of the block.
gui.hextale.port.inlet.hint: A pipe here brings the mixture in (green, arrow in)
gui.hextale.port.product.hint: The wanted product leaves here (blue, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.waste.hint: The by-product leaves here (rust, stopcock, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.none.hint: Nothing goes in or out here; no pipe joins it
gui.hextale.separator.vent.hint: The top lets out the gas of separation
item.hextale.essence_flask.unknown.hint: Dark murk left over after separating. No good for ink. Where to put it?
block.hextale.drain_valve.open: Valve open: what the pipes bring pours out
gui.hextale.alembic.water.hint: Each item boils in %s mB. Pipe water in from a Pump on any side, or pour a water bucket on the alembic
jei.hextale.boiling.heat: Heat under the alembic: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
jei.hextale.boiling.result: A mixture of the item's essences - study the item at the Research Table to know them
jei.hextale.info.alembic: Boils items into essences, unstudied ones into unknown. Needs water and fire, lava, magma or a Chem Burner below.
jei.hextale.info.separator: Pulls one chosen essence out of a mixture, the rest gets some unknown essence. Runs on blaze powder or a Chem Burner.
jei.hextale.info.essence_tank: Fills from any side and empties from the bottom. With an Essence Sticker it takes only one pure essence. (Bottle of Essence: pour in. Glass bottle: fill. Shift + right click with an empty hand: peel the sticker)
jei.hextale.info.brass_pipe: Carries essence and water into machine ports. Each side can be shut or made one-way, and an outgoing side drains a jar. (Shift + right click a side with an empty hand)
jei.hextale.info.pump: Placed in a water source, it pushes water up into the pipe on its top.
jei.hextale.info.drain_valve: Pours out what the pipes bring and drains a nearby jar. Spills turn stone into Magic Stone and make the land sicker. (Right click: open or shut)
jei.hextale.info.research_table: Drag the loupe onto an item to see its essences. Devices are researched on the board with ink from pure essence jars.
jei.hextale.info.essence_flask: Pours into a jar or a Crucible. Drunk, its essences give short effects, and unknown essence brings nausea and poison.
commands.hextale.quests.reset: Reset the Researcher's Path quests of %s
commands.hextale.guide.granted: Marked %1$s guide steps done for %2$s players
quest.hextale.research_table.desc: A proper desk at last, with room for the diary, the paper and a hextech orb. On one tab I pick the research, on the other I do it. The desk takes two blocks.
quest.hextale.brass.goal: melt Brass in the Awakened Furnace
quest.hextale.brass.desc: In the Awakened Furnace copper and zinc melt into brass. It is tougher than copper, and most of what I build will start with it.
quest.hextale.unstable_hextech.desc: When lightning hits a rod standing on amethyst, the strike can run into the amethyst and leave Unstable Hextech. I need a thunderstorm, or a place lightning struck long ago.
quest.hextale.glassy_scars.desc: Here and there the ground is fused into glass that branches out from a small pit. Lightning went deep here long ago. Digging down along the fulgurite should show what it hit.
quest.hextale.researchers_diary.desc: This diary has my name on the first page, and everything I find out goes in here. Next I need a desk to work at.
quest.hextale.item_study.desc: The loupe on the desk swings out on its arm. Dragged onto an item, it shows which essences the item is made of. Items made of a single essence are worth remembering.
quest.hextale.alembic.desc: The Alembic boils items over heat until their essences rise out. Only studied items give clear essence, the rest turn into unknown essence. I should start with one simple item.
quest.hextale.brass_pipe.desc: Carrying bottles by hand is tiring, so I need pipes. A pipe joins a machine only where the machine has a port. Any side of a pipe can be shut or made one-way. (Shift + right click with an empty hand)
quest.hextale.pump.desc: The Pump stands in a water source and pushes water up into the pipe on top of it. The pipe can carry the water on to an alembic.
quest.hextale.essence_bottle.desc: An Alembic flask holds all of an item's essences mixed, so only a single-essence item gives a pure one. Drunk, essences give short effects, and unknown essence makes me sick.
quest.hextale.separator.desc: The Separator draws one chosen essence out of a mixture and passes the rest on, stained with unknown essence. It burns blaze powder or sits on a lit Chem Burner.
quest.hextale.drain_valve.desc: The Drain Valve pours out whatever the pipes bring, which gets rid of the dark leftovers. Stone under the stream turns into Magic Stone, but spilled essence harms the land. (Right click: open or shut)
quest.hextale.concentrate.desc: A concentrate is one pure essence drawn out of a mixture. The Research Table can use it as ink, even for essences that no single item gives.
quest.hextale.essence_tank.desc: Essence goes into a jar from the top and the sides and comes out from the bottom. A sticker lets only one essence into it.
quest.hextale.ink.goal: open the table with a jar of pure essence nearby
quest.hextale.ink.desc: The desk takes ink from nearby jars of pure essence, one essence per jar, and research needs several. The first ink comes from boiling one pure item in the Alembic.
goggles.hextale.network: In the vessels on this network:
quest.hextale.researchers_goggles.desc: With these goggles on, I can see what is inside jars and pipes without opening anything.
research.hextale.burst: A curse! The orb burst and the parchment of %s burned with the ink spent on it. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
research.hextale.burnt: The parchment of %s burned. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
quest.hextale.hexcore.goal: wake the altar into a Hexcore
quest.hextale.hexcore.desc: A Hextech Gemstone wakes the Ritual Altar into a Hexcore that runs every altar ritual. Heavy rituals make it throw arcs around. Lightning rods catch them, and nullstone calms it.
jei.hextale.info.hexcore: Heavy rituals make it strike nearby players and blocks. Lightning rods within 8 blocks and nullstone within 6 calm it.
block.hextale.rune_circle.nothing: The circle has nothing to burn in: check the steles and the jars
block.hextale.rune_circle.hint: Burns runes from the steles around it into tools and devices, or copies them onto blank scrolls. (Right click with the item: place it; Shift + right click with an empty hand: start)
block.hextale.rune_circle.elsewhere: The circle only burns runes in and copies them: things are made at the altar
block.hextale.rune_circle.busy: A ritual is running - sneak + use to abort it (what was drawn is lost)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.elsewhere: The altar makes things: runes are burned in at a Rune Circle
jei.hextale.info.rune_circle: Burns the runes of the Rune Steles around it into the item in the middle, or writes them on a Blank Scroll. (Right click with the item: place. Shift + right click with an empty hand or redstone: start)
quest.hextale.rune_circle.desc: The altar only makes things, so runes are burned in at a Rune Circle. The item goes in the middle and the runes go on the steles around it. (Shift + right click with an empty hand: start)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing: The circle does not know what to do with this: check the pedestals, steles and jars
block.hextale.hextech_altar.busy: A ritual is running - sneak + use to abort it (what was drawn is lost)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.hint: The centre of the ritual circle where items are made. Put the item on top and start the ritual. (Right click with the item: place it; Shift + right click with an empty hand: start)
gui.hextale.stele.subtitle: Choose a rune for the circle
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.twice: Already on another stele of this circle
gui.hextale.stele.none: No rune does anything for the item in the circle.
gui.hextale.stele.unknown: A rune you have not learned yet
gui.hextale.stele.choose: Click: set it on the stele
gui.hextale.stele.pick_stars: Click a star: choose the strength (weaker too)
book.hextale.quest.infusion.missing: The altar recipe is not loaded
quest.hextale.hextech_altar.desc: The Ritual Altar is the centre of a ritual circle. The main item goes on the altar, the rest on pedestals around it, with jars of essence nearby. (Shift + right click with an empty hand: start)
quest.hextale.pedestal.desc: Pedestals hold the items a ritual needs, one each, close to the altar. Hoppers can fill them. The altar marks an item it does not need in red.
quest.hextale.rune_stele.desc: A Rune Stele holds one rune I know. Placed around a Rune Circle, it gives that rune to the item in the middle. It only offers runes that fit that item.
quest.hextale.hextech_pickaxe.desc: The Runed Pickaxe is an iron pickaxe with a raw orb in a brass collar. It digs like iron, but it has room for a rune. Runes could make it much better.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_altar: The main item goes on top, the rest on Pedestals within 6 blocks, essence from jars within 8. Chalk runes speed it up. (Right click with the item: place. Shift + right click with an empty hand or redstone: start)
jei.hextale.info.pedestal: Holds one ritual ingredient within 6 blocks of the Ritual Altar. Hoppers can fill it too.
jei.hextale.info.rune_stele: Holds one rune you know. Steles within 5 blocks of a Rune Circle give it their runes. (Right click: choose a rune)
gui.hextale.separator.choose.hint: Click: choose from all essences. Right click: clear. Wheel: next / previous
gui.hextale.separator.missing: The mixture holds none of it
gui.hextale.separator.no_fuel: Needs blaze powder or heat below
gui.hextale.separator.no_fuel.hint: One blaze powder draws 32 mB of the chosen essence; a lit Chem Burner below heats it for free, magma or lava below slowly
gui.hextale.slot.separator.fuel: Blaze powder: burned to draw the chosen essence out
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.volatile: Looks very fragile - I'd better not drop it.
item.hextale.hextech_gemstone.tooltip: A Hextech Crystal finished at the Lapidary. Fully stable, it never bursts.
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.goal: finish a Hextech Gemstone on the lapidary
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.desc: A crystal ground with the master disc stops trembling for good. The gemstone is the purest hextech I can make and holds far more than a cut crystal.
quest.hextale.hextech_lamp.desc: The Crystal Lamp is a hextech crystal floating in a small brass cage. It shines as bright as day and never goes out. I can stand it on a block or hang it like a lantern.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_lamp: Gives bright light that never goes out, standing or hanging like a lantern. It flickers where the land has sickness.
quest.hextale.magic_stone.goal: make magic stone in the crucible
quest.hextale.magic_stone.desc: Stone thrown into a Crucible with magic essence comes out as Magic Stone. Lapis gives the water its magic. It builds well, and later recipes need it.
jei.hextale.info.magic_stone: Stone soaked with magic essence in a Crucible or under a Drain Valve. It is the base of a set of building blocks.
quest.hextale.magic_sapling.goal: grow a Magic Tree Sprout in the crucible
quest.hextale.magic_sapling.desc: A sapling in a Crucible with magic, plant and sap essence becomes a Magic Tree Sprout. First I have to work it out at the Lab Bench. Its wood does not burn.
jei.hextale.info.magic_sapling: Grows into a magic tree whose wood does not burn. Its Crucible recipe needs research at the Lab Bench first.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing.rune: The circle waits for runes on its steles: %s
book.hextale.quest.infusion.runes: Runes chosen on steles around the circle
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.clas: %s and %s are incompatible on one pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pickaxe holds four runes (a grindstone takes them off)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.noth: The pickaxe already carries these runes with as many stars
book.hextale.quest.pickaxe_rune.note: Runes per pickaxe: Runed 1, Refined 2, Radiant 3, Riftforged %s. A grindstone takes all runes off.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note: Pickaxe in the Rune Circle, rune on a stele. Runes: 1, refined 2, radiant 3, attuned %s.
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.goal: burn a rune into a runed pickaxe
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.desc: A Runed Pickaxe has room for a rune. In the Rune Circle, a rune on a stele beside it sinks into the metal like an enchantment. I should try my first rune scroll.
quest.hextale.refined_pickaxe.desc: On the Ritual Altar the old pickaxe gets harder and sharper. It keeps every rune and gets room for a second one. The same research covers the axe, the shovel and the sword.
quest.hextale.radiant_pickaxe.desc: On the Hexcore the pickaxe becomes radiant, and fire can no longer harm it. It keeps its runes and gets room for a third. Riftmetal from the Void could take it even further.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.smelting.desc: Drops come out already smelted, with some experience. Ore sometimes gives an extra ingot.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.tempering.desc: The pickaxe often takes no wear and digs hard stone like deepslate faster.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: Breaking one ore block breaks the whole vein with it. (Shift: one block)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.insight.desc: Ores around you glow through the stone for a few seconds. (Right click)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.drill.desc: Digs a whole area around the block at once. (Shift: one block)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Ore sometimes drops twice as much.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.gemstone.desc: Stone sometimes drops a gem: amethyst, lapis, an emerald or a diamond.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.magnet.desc: While you hold the pickaxe, dropped items and experience orbs nearby fly to you.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.cache.desc: Drops go straight into your inventory.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.passage.desc: Digs a 3x3 tunnel straight ahead. (Right click)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.quake.desc: Breaks the stone around the block you look at and leaves ores and other blocks in place. The stone drops nothing. (Right click)
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.goal: build a Big Essence Jar and wake it
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.desc: One jar is never enough, so glass blocks with a wooden lid can be built into a Big Essence Jar. Hextech Dust wakes the finished shape. It holds as much as sixteen jars.
gui.hextale.multiblock.hint: The arrows step through the layers
jei.hextale.multiblock.wake: Right-click the finished structure (one is spent)
book.hextale.guide.no_use: No use for it yet. It feels like it leads somewhere, though.
book.hextale.guide.researched_at_lab: Worked out at the Lab Bench
item.hextale.scroll_of_omniscience.desc: Teaches every rune at three stars, studies every item and completes every quest. (Right click: read)
item.hextale.scroll_of_oblivion.desc: Forgets all learned runes, studied items and quests. (Right click: read)
item.hextale.void_shard.desc: A creative tool that opens and closes breaches of the Void.
item.hextale.void_shard.controls: (Right click: open a breach; Shift + right click: close the breach in sight or pick another shape)
subtitles.hextale.essence.draw: Essence is drawn from a jar
quest.hextale.hextech_axe.desc: The Runed Axe is an iron axe with a raw orb set at the head. It chops like iron and has room for one rune.
quest.hextale.hextech_shovel.desc: The Runed Shovel is an iron shovel with a raw orb set in brass. It digs like iron and has room for one rune.
quest.hextale.hextech_sword.desc: The Runed Sword has a hexagonal guard around a raw orb. It cuts like an iron sword and has room for one rune. A Tendril Dagger for the other hand comes from the same research.
block.hextale.xp_condenser.hint: Absorbs experience orbs that appear nearby and stores the experience. (Right click: take a level; Shift + right click: take all; right click with a glass bottle: Bottle o' Enchanting)
block.hextale.xp_condenser.too_little: Too little in the glass for a bottle (%s needed)
quest.hextale.xp_condenser.desc: The condenser catches experience orbs nearby before they even appear and stores them as a green liquid. A glass bottle draws some off as a Bottle o' Enchanting.
jei.hextale.info.xp_condenser: Catches experience orbs within 8 blocks before they appear and stores up to about 50 levels. Breaking it releases them. (Right click: one level. Shift + right click: all. Glass bottle: Bottle o' Enchanting)
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.gathering: Gathers within %s blocks every %s s, %s at a time · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.sending: Sends %s items every %s s, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.relay: Passes items on, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.start: Right click a storage or a relay within %s blocks to link (%s/%s); a linked one to unlink; anywhere else to stop
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.far: Too far: %s blocks, the pylon reaches %s
pylon_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The pylon gathers from a wider area and links over longer distances.
pylon_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The pylon sends cargo more often.
pylon_rune.hextale.lift.desc: The pylon moves more items at once.
pylon_rune.hextale.smelting.desc: Carried items that a furnace can smelt sometimes arrive smelted.
pylon_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: Carried stone sometimes arrives ground down: cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand.
pylon_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Deliveries sometimes leave a little experience at the target.
book.hextale.quest.pylon_rune.note: Each pylon holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_pylon: Pylon in the Rune Circle, rune on a stele. Up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a pylon
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pylon holds three runes
quest.hextale.gathering_pylon.desc: This pylon uses the pull of a gem instead of a mechanical arm. Set on a chest or a furnace, it picks up items lying around and lowers them in. I want to see how far it reaches.
quest.hextale.sending_pylon.desc: This pylon gives instead of taking: whatever the container under it gives out, it carries to where I point. A furnace even sorts what it gets by itself. (Right click the pylon, then the target)
quest.hextale.relay_pylon.desc: This column keeps nothing for itself and only passes things along its links. With a chain of them I could reach across the whole base.
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.goal: burn a rune into a pylon
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.desc: Pylons have room for runes too. Laid in the Rune Circle, a pylon could take runes that let it reach further and work faster.
jei.hextale.info.gathering_pylon: Picks up nearby items into the container below, or sends them along its links if there is none. (Right click the pylon, then a target: link. Shift + right click with an empty hand: clear links)
jei.hextale.info.sending_pylon: Sends items from the container below to its links. Furnaces get ingredients on top and fuel at the side. (Right click the pylon, then a target: link or unlink. Shift + right click with an empty hand: clear links)
jei.hextale.info.relay_pylon: Keeps nothing for itself: items and essence pass on along its links. A chain of relay pylons carries things far.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.link: Right click, then right click a storage face or a relay: link
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.clear: Sneak + right click with an empty hand: take all links away
block.hextale.gathering_pylon.hint: Place it on a container. It picks up items lying nearby and puts them into the container or sends them to linked blocks. (Right click the pylon, then a block: link)
block.hextale.sending_pylon.hint: Place it on a container. It takes items out and sends them to linked blocks. (Right click the pylon, then a block: link)
block.hextale.relay_pylon.hint: Takes nothing by itself. It passes items from other pylons on to its own links. (Right click the pylon, then a block: link)
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.untie: Sneak + right click a linked block with an empty hand: untie it
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace: Every %s s, %s items at a time
goggles.hextale.pylon.untie: Sneak + right click with an empty hand: untie
block.hextale.siphon_pylon.hint: Place it on an Essence Jar. It sends the jar's essence to linked jars and devices. (Right click the pylon, then a block: link)
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.siphon: Pours %s mB every %s s, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace_mb: Every %s s, %s mB at a time
quest.hextale.siphon_pylon.desc: This pylon can replace pipes. Set on a jar, it draws the essence up and sends it as a stream of light to wherever I point. (Right click the pylon, then the target)
jei.hextale.info.siphon_pylon: Placed on a jar, it sends the jar's essence as a stream of light to its linked targets that accept it. (Right click the pylon, then the target: link)
item.hextale.pylon_filter.hint: Sets which items a pylon takes. (Right click: set up; right click a pylon: insert; Shift + right click a pylon: take out)
item.hextale.pylon_filter.not_here: A siphon carries essence: give it an Essence Sticker instead
item.hextale.essence_sticker.blank: Blank: right click to choose its essence
item.hextale.essence_sticker.hint: A jar with this sticker accepts only the chosen essence. It does not accept mixtures either.
item.hextale.essence_sticker.not_here: A sticker goes on a jar, a siphon or a relay
gui.hextale.sticker.title: Essence on the sticker
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.list: Only these: only the listed items pass. All but these: the listed items never pass. An empty filter lets everything pass.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.exact: Kind: every stack of that item. Exact: only with the same enchantments, contents and damage.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.rule: Numbers (with "Only these"): keep N - a sending pylon leaves N of each item in its container; fill up to N - an item goes in only while the target holds fewer than N. Scroll over a slot to set N, with shift by ten.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.empty: Empty: everything passes. Put items into the slots.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.blackli: Everything passes except the items here.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.keep: Only these pass, and N of each stays behind.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.limit: Only these pass, each up to N in the target.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.empty: Click with an item to put it here
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.hint: Click: replace or clear · scroll: N (shift: by ten)
quest.hextale.pylon_filter.desc: The pylons grab everything. A Filter tells a pylon what to take, what to leave and how much to keep back. (Right click: set it up, then right click a pylon to put it in)
quest.hextale.essence_sticker.desc: An Essence Sticker is a small label for one essence. On a jar it keeps every other essence out. A mixture stays a mixture, though, and no sticker will split it.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.no_load: Nothing here takes items or essence
item.hextale.research_notes.read: Use to read: then you can make it
item.hextale.research_notes.known: You have researched %s already. Hand the notes to another researcher.
item.hextale.research_notes.learned: Researched: %s. You can make it now.
item.hextale.research_notes.rune: Between the lines of the notes a rune is sketched: %s
research.hextale.locked: Research %s at the Research Table first
research.hextale.locked_lab: Research %s at the Lab Bench first
hextale.protected: Protected: someone else holds this place
gui.hextale.research_table.researched: Researched already: this makes a copy of the notes
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.hint: Start this research over on a fresh sheet with a new board. The paper is lost, the orb and the ink stay.
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.confirm: Click again to burn the parchment
gui.hextale.research_table.goal.hint: Reach it with the ink; a step onto it costs %s of its essence
gui.hextale.research_table.corner.hint: Every step towards this corner is paid with it
book.hextale.runes.title: Runes found: %s
book.hextale.runes.none: Not a single rune yet. They aren't invented - they're found on scrolls in the chests of old places. The deeper and more dangerous the place, the stranger the rune.
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.one_scroll: A scroll takes one rune: clear the rune on the other stele
block.hextale.hextech_altar.write.one_ru: To copy a rune you need a blank scroll in the rune circle and one rune on one stele
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.goal: find a rune scroll and read it
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.desc: Runes cannot be invented, they are found on Rune Scrolls. Scrolls lie in chests in old places, and each set of Research Notes gives one too. A scroll teaches me its rune for good.
quest.hextale.blank_scroll.desc: A rune I know can be copied onto a Blank Scroll at the Rune Circle. Then I can give the scroll to someone else.
quest.hextale.written_scroll.goal: copy a rune onto a scroll
quest.hextale.written_scroll.desc: The Rune Circle copies a rune from one stele onto a Blank Scroll in the middle, at the strength I know it. Anyone who reads the scroll learns that rune.
jei.hextale.info.blank_scroll: In a Rune Circle with one rune on a stele, the rune is written onto it. Writing uses essence from jars nearby.
jei.hextale.info.rune_scroll: Found in chests, rare runes deeper and in more dangerous ruins. Reading it teaches the rune at its 1 to 3 stars. (Right click)
jei.hextale.info.research_notes: Reading teaches you to make the thing and gives a scroll of one of its runes you lack. Any player can read them. (Right click)
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.throw: And if I threw it on purpose? (Right click)
item.hextale.hextech_dust.tooltip: Awakens ordinary blocks into hextech ones. (Right click a crafting table, furnace, cauldron, dead bush or a built multiblock: awaken it)
item.hextale.hextech_crystal.tooltip: Unstable Hextech cut at the Lapidary. It no longer bursts and can power hextech devices.
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_a_bucket: Not enough water for a bucket
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_boiling: Only boiling water takes things in - heat it from below and wait
block.hextale.crucible.say.no_water: The crucible is dry: pour in a water bucket or water bottles
block.hextale.crucible.status.cold: %s - water %s mB. Light a fire, a campfire, magma or lava under it
block.hextale.dormant_hextech.tooltip: Amethyst changed by an old lightning strike, found in struck geodes. Drops Unstable Hextech when mined.
block.hextale.hextech_cluster.tooltip: A fully grown hextech crystal that glows and gives off sparks. Drops Unstable Hextech when broken.
block.hextale.fulgurite.tooltip: Sand fused into glass by lightning. Smelt it to get Fulgurite Glass.
jei.hextale.info.dormant_hextech: Found in amethyst hollows deep under fulgurite craters. Mined, it drops 1 or 2 Unstable Hextech, more with Fortune.
jei.hextale.info.fulgurite: Forms where lightning strikes sand, and lines the craters above hextech geodes. It smelts into Fulgurite Glass.
gui.hextale.hex_workbench.no_charge: Not enough charge: put a raw hextech orb or a synthetic crystal into the socket
gui.hextale.hex_workbench.charge.hint: Raw hextech in the socket soaks into the bench as charge (unstable orb %s, crystal grown in shimmer %s, up to %s); every craft spends some.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_workbench.crystal: A raw hextech orb or a synthetic crystal: its charge powers the crafts
gui.hextale.hex_furnace.fuel.hint: Anything that burns in a furnace.
gui.hextale.hex_furnace.locked: This alloy must be researched first
gui.hextale.slot.hex_furnace.input: A metal for the alloy: up to three different ones
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.no_crystal: Put a crystal into the clamp
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.wrong_disc: A crystal is finished only on a master disc
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.heat.hint: Grinding heats the crystal, resting cools it. At the top it cracks.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.input: Raw hextech, or a hextech crystal to finish
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.output: The cut stone (or dust, if it shattered)
book.hextale.quest.scheme.void_carapace: in a Crucible with decay essence
quest.hextale.hextech_dust.desc: A hextech orb cannot take a blow. Thrown, it shatters into glittering Hextech Dust. The dust still holds magic, so I should try sprinkling it on things. (Right click with the orb: throw)
quest.hextale.hex_workbench.desc: Hextech Dust sprinkled on a crafting table sinks into the wood and wakes it. The Awakened Workbench needs charge for its own recipes, and a raw orb in its socket gives it. (Right click a crafting table with Hextech Dust)
quest.hextale.crucible.desc: Hextech Dust turns a cauldron into a Crucible. Almost anything thrown in dissolves, but some things come out changed. I should find out which.
quest.hextale.hex_furnace.desc: Hextech Dust sprinkled on a furnace wakes it into an Awakened Furnace. It melts two or three metals together into alloys. Some alloys it will only make after I research them.
quest.hextale.sphalerite.desc: Sphalerite is a dull brown stone with honey-coloured grains. It lies deep in the rock like copper, only rarer, and it gives Raw Zinc.
quest.hextale.zinc.desc: Raw Zinc melts into ingots in any furnace. It is grey and plain, but it is exactly what copper needs to become brass.
quest.hextale.hex_lapidary.desc: The Lapidary cuts Unstable Hextech along its hidden seams. The seam must line up with the disc before each short stroke. Heat cracks the crystal, so strokes need pauses.
quest.hextale.hextech_crystal.desc: A Hextech Crystal is unstable hextech cut along its seams. It holds steady now and no longer bursts. Most of the devices ahead are built around one.
quest.hextale.hexsteel.desc: Iron melted with Hextech Dust in the Awakened Furnace comes out as dark blue Hexsteel. The dust stays in the steel, and it holds an edge as well as diamond.
quest.hextale.charged_hexsteel.desc: In a Crucible with circuit essence, Hexsteel takes in a charge as thin blue seams. Coolant on hot hexsteel over a Chem Burner is faster, but worsens the sickness.
quest.hextale.engraved_diamond.goal: engrave a diamond on the Lapidary
quest.hextale.engraved_diamond.desc: A diamond is harder than any of our crystals, and hextech slides off it. Cut with a groove in one face, it might hold the charge after all. Only the Master Cutting Disc can cut it.
quest.hextale.radiant_alloy.goal: melt Radiant Alloy in the Foundry
quest.hextale.radiant_alloy.desc: Finishing a gemstone leaves bright Gemstone Dust, and the Foundry melts it with gold into white Radiant Alloy. Refined Shimmer can stand in for the dust, but worsens the sickness.
quest.hextale.void_carapace.goal: soften Void Chitin in the crucible
quest.hextale.void_carapace.desc: Void Chitin is too brittle to use as it is. In a Crucible with decay essence it softens into Void Carapace, a light plate that is cold to the touch. It could make strong armour.
quest.hextale.void_crystal.goal: study a Void Crystal under the loupe
quest.hextale.void_crystal.desc: Void Crystals grow on lumps of dark flesh where the skin sags lowest between the ribs. They are dark violet with a black core. Before I use one, I should study it under the loupe.
quest.hextale.sealed_void_crystal.goal: seal a Void Crystal in nullstone and Void skin
quest.hextale.sealed_void_crystal.desc: Nullstone absorbs stray magic, so it can seal a Void Crystal. Sealed under Void Membrane and tinted glass, the crystal is safe to work with.
quest.hextale.riftmetal.desc: Raw Riftmetal crumbles in fire on its own. With Radiant Alloy in the Awakened Furnace it holds together, keeping violet sparks inside. It is the metal for the next tier of tools.
quest.hextale.riftforged_tools.goal: forge a Riftforged tool on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.riftforged_tools.desc: Around the Hexcore, Riftmetal and Void Crystals turn radiant tools into riftforged ones. They come out darker and hold four runes. One research covers the whole set.
quest.hextale.strike_gauntlet.goal: make a Strike Gauntlet on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.strike_gauntlet.desc: The Strike Gauntlet is a brass fist with a piston that charges while held. Released, it breaks rock or throws back whatever is in front. Held too long, it vents and starts over. (Hold right click, then release)
quest.hextale.bulwark.desc: The Bulwark's heart, a raw orb in the chest, spends charge to soak up part of each blow. Raw hextech recharges it. Run dry, it cracks in a flash that throws creatures back.
quest.hextale.refined_bulwark.desc: The Bulwark gets the same refinement as the tools. The plates now hold two runes, and the heart soaks up more of each blow.
quest.hextale.radiant_bulwark.goal: make Radiant Bulwark on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.radiant_bulwark.desc: Radiant Bulwark is white gold etched with acid, with a gemstone for a heart. The armour holds three runes, and the heart soaks up half of each blow.
quest.hextale.riftforged_bulwark.goal: forge Riftforged Bulwark on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.riftforged_bulwark.desc: Riftmetal and Void Carapace go over the radiant plates, and a Void Pearl becomes the heart. The armour holds four runes, and the heart soaks up even more of each blow.
quest.hextale.hexsteel_gear.goal: forge a piece of hexsteel gear
quest.hextale.hexsteel_gear.desc: Hexsteel tools and armour are made at an ordinary crafting table and hold up as well as diamond. They take no runes, though.
quest.hextale.master_cutting_disc.desc: The old disc is too coarse for the fine cut. A hexsteel disc edged with diamond should cut more planes and leave less room for mistakes. I can make it on the Ritual Altar.
jei.hextale.info.hex_furnace: Smelts two or three metals into an alloy on ordinary fuel, and single items like a furnace. Some alloys need research.
jei.hextale.info.crucible: With water inside and heat below, items dropped in dissolve into essence, and catalysts turn it into new items or brews. (Empty hand: take out results. Shift + right click twice with an empty hand: boil away)
jei.hextale.info.hex_workbench: Crafts most devices from researched recipes, each craft using charge from the crystal in its socket.
jei.hextale.info.hex_lapidary: Cuts hextech into crystals and gemstones. Line its seam up with the disc and grind in short strokes, or it cracks.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_dust: Thrown Unstable Hextech shatters into this dust. It awakens a crafting table, furnace, cauldron or dead bush. (Right click the block)
jei.hextale.working.lightning: Lightning hitting a rod on an amethyst block shatters it and the amethyst touching it into Unstable Hextech.
jei.hextale.working.throw: A thrown orb shatters into 2 or 3 hextech dust. (Right click: throw)
jei.hextale.working.awaken: (Right click the block with the dust)
jei.hextale.working.engrave: Only a Master Cutting Disc can cut a diamond. Engraved diamonds go into refined tools and armour.
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.turn: Turn the crystal (wheel or A/D) until the band glows green
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.aligned: Green! Hold the mouse or space to grind
block.hextale.crucible.say.no_essences: There is nothing in it for the water to dissolve
jei.hextale.info.essence: One of 22 essences, seen in items with the Research Table's loupe. Searching its name lists studied items that carry it.
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.hint: Harvests ripe crops around it with whirlwinds, and the plants grow again. Uses Air Essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.status: Field %sx%s, a whirl every %s s, air for %s whirls
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.status.becalm: Becalmed: no air essence in the jars nearby
reaper_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The reaper harvests a wider field.
reaper_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The reaper sends out whirls more often.
book.hextale.quest.reaper_rune.note: A Whirl Reaper holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_reaper: Put the Whirl Reaper in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.whirl_reaper.desc: The crystal spins the air into small whirls. Set among the beds, the reaper harvests ripe crops and leaves the plants to grow again. It runs on air essence.
jei.hextale.info.whirl_reaper: Reaps ripe plants within 4 blocks with whirls of wind and leaves them to regrow. It uses air essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.hint: Fells grown trees nearby with their leaves and replants saplings, sparing builds. Uses Air Essence from nearby jars.
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.status: Grove %sx%s, a saw every %s s, air for %s trees
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.status.becalme: Becalmed: no air essence in the jars nearby
sawmill_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The sawmill reaches trees farther away.
sawmill_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The sawmill sends out saws more often.
book.hextale.quest.sawmill_rune.note: A Whirl Sawmill holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_sawmill: Put the Whirl Sawmill in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.hex_sawmill.desc: The wind spins a disc set in an old stump. Placed in a grove, the sawmill fells grown trees and replants saplings, but leaves log walls alone. It runs on air essence.
jei.hextale.info.hex_sawmill: Fells grown natural trees within 6 blocks and replants them, sparing log buildings. Uses air essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.hint: On a chest, it stores the loot of mobs dying nearby and keeps their experience. Uses Decay Essence from nearby jars. (Right click: take the experience)
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.status: Reach %sx%s, decay for %s deaths, %s experience in the crystal
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.status.hungr: Hungry: no decay essence in the jars nearby
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.status.full: Full: the container below takes no more
funnel_rune.hextale.shift.desc: Catches deaths in a larger radius.
funnel_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Each death puts more experience into the crystal.
funnel_rune.hextale.spoils.desc: Stackable drops sometimes come with one extra item.
funnel_rune.hextale.engraving.desc: Mobs that die around it sometimes drop their head too.
funnel_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a death costs the funnel no decay essence.
funnel_rune.hextale.sponge.desc: Sometimes the essences of the drops also flow into a jar next to the funnel. The drops stay.
book.hextale.quest.funnel_rune.note: A Greedy Funnel holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_funnel: Put the Greedy Funnel in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.greedy_funnel.desc: A nullstone bowl over a chest catches what the dead leave behind: drops go into the chest, experience into its crystal. It feeds on decay essence, and bones are full of it.
jei.hextale.info.greedy_funnel: Drops of mobs dying nearby go into the container below, experience into its store. Uses decay essence from nearby jars. (Right click: take the experience)
block.hextale.arc_spire.hint: Its arcs kill hostile mobs nearby with full player loot and experience. Uses Lightning Essence from nearby jars.
block.hextale.arc_spire.status: Reach %sx%s, an arc every %s s at %s creature(s), spark for %s arcs
block.hextale.arc_spire.status.uncharged: Uncharged: no spark essence in the jars nearby
block.hextale.arc_spire.status.waiting: Waiting: the funnel that takes its kills is full
spire_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The spire reaches mobs farther away.
spire_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The spire fires arcs more often.
spire_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.desc: Each arc hits more mobs at once.
spire_rune.hextale.flash.desc: Arcs deal more damage to mobs at full health.
spire_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes an arc uses no Lightning Essence.
spire_rune.hextale.beam.desc: The arc becomes a hot beam that sets its targets on fire. Mobs it kills drop cooked meat.
book.hextale.quest.spire_rune.note: An Arc Spire holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_spire: Put the Arc Spire in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.arc_spire.desc: The Arc Spire strikes hostile creatures nearby with arcs from its crystal. The kills count as mine, with all their loot and experience. It feeds on lightning essence.
jei.hextale.info.arc_spire: Its arcs kill hostile mobs as a player would, with experience and rare loot. Uses lightning essence from jars nearby.
quest.hextale.binding_chalk.goal: close a figure drawn in Binding Chalk
quest.hextale.binding_chalk.desc: Chalk steeped in shadow draws lines that join up. A closed figure holds the creatures inside it still. It needs shadow essence from jars nearby, or the chalk wears thin. (Right click the top of a block: draw a line)
block.hextale.miasma_vent.hint: Hurts and poisons hostile mobs nearby, undead too, and needs no fuel. Its kills give no experience. (Redstone signal: shut it)
quest.hextale.miasma_vent.desc: The Miasma Vent breathes poison over the ground and needs no fuel. Hostile mobs in it slowly die, while players and animals only cough. Its kills give no experience or rare loot. (A redstone signal shuts it)
jei.hextale.info.miasma_vent: Poisons hostile mobs within 4 blocks, undead too, with no fuel. Its kills give no experience or rare loot. (A redstone signal shuts it)
block.hextale.miasma_vent.status.shut: Shut: a redstone signal holds the stack closed
block.hextale.sorting_matrix.hint: Place it on the chest you dump items into. It sends each item to a nearby chest that already holds the same item.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.sorting: Sorts %s of each item every %s s into storages within %s blocks · links %s/%s
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace_kinds: Every %s s, %s of each item, up to %s kinds
quest.hextale.sorting_matrix.desc: The matrix sits on the chest where I dump everything. It sends each item to a nearby chest that already holds the same. One cobblestone starts a cobblestone chest.
jei.hextale.info.sorting_matrix: Moves each item from the chest below to storage nearby that holds the same, or to a linked target that takes it.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Digging sometimes gives you Haste for a few seconds.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Blocks drop as with Fortune, added to the pickaxe's own Fortune. Does nothing with Silk Touch.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Ore gives more experience, and iron, copper and gold ore give some too. Stone sometimes gives a little.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Digging sometimes restores a little hunger. Under water, every block you break gives back some air.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: Digging in the dark gives you Night Vision.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: Breaking a block next to lava gives you Fire Resistance.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: When you dig in the dark, a Wisp sometimes appears where the block was and lights up the area.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The pickaxe sometimes takes no wear and repairs a point of durability instead.
reaper_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: A reaped plant is sometimes bonemealed right away.
reaper_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: A harvest sometimes gives one or two more of its produce.
reaper_rune.hextale.photosynthesis.desc: A harvest sometimes gives a golden carrot, a glistering melon slice or a golden apple.
reaper_rune.hextale.spring.desc: Every harvest fully wets the farmland around, and plants next to it may grow a step.
reaper_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: A harvest sometimes gives a point of experience at the reaper.
reaper_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a whirl uses no air essence.
sawmill_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A replanted sapling sometimes grows into a tree right away.
sawmill_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: Leaves drop as with Fortune: more saplings, sticks and apples.
sawmill_rune.hextale.blades.desc: Each log sometimes drops one more.
sawmill_rune.hextale.photosynthesis.desc: A felled tree sometimes drops a golden apple.
sawmill_rune.hextale.hush.desc: Bee nests and beehives on felled trees drop whole, with the bees and honey inside.
sawmill_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes felling a tree uses no air essence.
furnace_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Ores and raw metal sometimes give one extra ingot.
furnace_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a smelt uses no fuel.
furnace_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: Smelts faster the longer it works without a break.
furnace_rune.hextale.reforging.desc: Iron, gold and copper tools and armor smelt into ingots instead of nuggets.
tool_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The tool sometimes takes no wear and repairs a point of durability instead.
tool_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Chopping and digging sometimes give you Haste for a few seconds.
tool_rune.hextale.gravity.desc: Chopping one log fells the whole tree with its leaves. Log walls are safe. (Shift: one block)
tool_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A tree cut at its base is planted again with a sapling from your inventory, or sometimes for free.
tool_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: Leaves broken with the axe drop as with Fortune: more saplings, sticks and apples.
tool_rune.hextale.corrosion.desc: Hits sometimes eat through armour: they deal extra damage and wear down the target's armour.
tool_rune.hextale.cache.desc: Dirt, sand and gravel sometimes hold a find: bones, flint, nuggets, rarely an emerald, a diamond or a Rune Scroll.
tool_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: Digs a whole area around the block at once. (Shift: one block)
tool_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Grass and dirt sometimes drop seeds, crops or a sapling.
tool_rune.hextale.withering.desc: Hits sometimes heal you a little.
tool_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.desc: Hits sometimes let out a spark that deals extra damage and jumps on to nearby hostile mobs.
tool_rune.hextale.spoils.desc: Mobs killed with this weapon drop more loot, as with Looting.
tool_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Mobs killed with this weapon drop more experience.
tool_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: Kills sometimes give you Strength for a few seconds.
tool_rune.hextale.flash.desc: Hits on a creature at full health deal more damage.
tool_rune.hextale.backstab.desc: Hits from behind deal more damage.
tool_rune.hextale.bleeding.desc: Hits sometimes open a wound that keeps hurting the target for a few seconds.
tool_rune.hextale.engraving.desc: Mobs killed with this tool sometimes drop their head.
tool_rune.hextale.shockwave.desc: Sends a wave along the ground that hurts and tosses mobs in its path. (Full-strength swing at the ground)
tool_rune.hextale.blink.desc: Moves you behind the creature you look at and hits it with extra damage. (Right click at a creature)
tool_rune.hextale.detonator.desc: Mobs killed with this weapon burst and hurt the creatures around them. Players, villagers and pets are safe.
tool_rune.hextale.whirlpool.desc: Hits sometimes open a whirlpool at the target that pulls nearby mobs in and slows them.
tool_rune.hextale.whirlwind.desc: Every third hit in a quick series also hits all creatures around you and pushes them back.

quest.hextale.hex_wisp.desc: Light and lightning essence in the crucible turn a torch into two Wisps. They are small flames that hang in the air and never go out. A dye changes their colour.

brew.hextale.growth.use: Where it shatters, plants within two blocks get bone meal twice and young animals grow up.
brew.hextale.coolant.use: Where it shatters, fire goes out, lava turns to obsidian or cobblestone, and burning creatures stop burning.
brew.hextale.glow.use: Where it shatters, patches of Chem Glow light up the blocks around, and creatures nearby start to glow.
brew.hextale.acid.use: Dissolves stone where it shatters, sparing ores, and burns monsters. Iron blocks turn into Rusted Plating, copper ages.
