jei.hextale.info.chem_vial: Fill a glass bottle from a Crucible's brew. Most brews are thrown, combustible mix is fuel and refined shimmer is drunk.
jei.hextale.info.rusted_plating: Splash acid on a block of iron to turn it into rusted plating. A rough building block.
burner_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a portion of fuel burns twice as long.
burner_rune.hextale.steam.desc: A brew made on the burner sometimes gives one extra dose.
burner_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Every brew made on the burner gives some experience.
burner_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: Players near the lit burner get Fire Resistance.

quest.hextale.chem_vial.desc: A catalyst thrown in last turns the essences in the boiling crucible into a brew, and a glass bottle draws a dose. The first brew to study at the Lab Bench is Combustible Mix.
quest.hextale.chem_glass.desc: Decay essence in the crucible turns glass into green Chem Glass. Chemtech devices are built from it, starting with the Lab Bench and the Chem Burner.
quest.hextale.chem_burner.desc: The Chem Burner's nearly invisible green flame is hotter than lava and burns only while the device on top works. It burns Combustible Mix or piped essence, unknown essence longest.
quest.hextale.rusted_plating.desc: Acid thrown at an iron block eats it into Rusted Plating. It looks rough but builds well, with stairs, slabs and a riveted version.
subtitles.hextale.crucible.brew: The crucible turns into a brew
brew.hextale.raw_shimmer.use: Long-burning fuel for the Chem Burner and the Pink Brazier. Refine it in the Chem Still to get a drinkable brew.
brew.hextale.refined_shimmer.use: A minute of Strength, Speed, Resistance and Haste, plus a vein (up to five) worth a heart and damage for twenty minutes.

tank_rune.hextale.spring.desc: Sometimes the axolotl sheds one more Regenerative Slime.
tank_rune.hextale.haste.desc: The axolotl sheds slime more often.
tank_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes the axolotl sheds slime without using up a meal.
tank_rune.hextale.healing.desc: Players near a fed tank get Regeneration.
still_rune.hextale.steam.desc: Refining sometimes gives a second vial.
still_rune.hextale.purification.desc: Refining sometimes also gives a Synthetic Crystal.
boiler_rune.hextale.steam.desc: Pressure builds faster, so batches are split more often.
boiler_rune.hextale.purifying_fire.desc: Sometimes a batch is split whole, with nothing lost to fumes or unknown essence.
lamppost_rune.hextale.shift.desc: Its light covers a larger area.
lamppost_rune.hextale.purification.desc: Burns off a larger share of the land sickness in its light.
lamppost_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes burning off land sickness uses no light essence.
lamppost_rune.hextale.healing.desc: Players in its light get Regeneration.
lamppost_rune.hextale.insight.desc: Hostile mobs in its light glow and can be seen through walls.
boiler_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Less of each batch escapes as fumes.
boiler_rune.hextale.purification.desc: Less of each batch burns down into unknown essence.
brazier_rune.hextale.shift.desc: Its light covers a larger area.
brazier_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: Sometimes works on a plant in its light like bone meal.
brazier_rune.hextale.healing.desc: Players in its light get Regeneration.
brazier_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a vial burns twice as long.

quest.hextale.shimmerbloom.desc: Shimmerbloom is a glowing violet flower from rare violet-lit caves deep underground. Bone meal grows a new one beside it. Next I should see what it leaves in the crucible.
quest.hextale.axolotl_tank.desc: An axolotl kept in this glass tank and fed fish now and then sheds a lump of Regenerative Slime. A bucket of tropical fish counts as several meals.
quest.hextale.regenerative_slime.desc: The axolotl's slime is the catalyst for raw shimmer, so I should keep a few lumps.
quest.hextale.raw_shimmer.desc: Raw Shimmer brews in the Crucible over soul fire or hotter, from Regenerative Slime or, in bigger batches, from Shimmer Bulbs. Study it at the Lab Bench first.
quest.hextale.chem_still.desc: The Chem Still is a copper still on a lit Chem Burner that refines raw shimmer. The finished vial waits in the receiver until I take it.
quest.hextale.chem_boiler.desc: The Chem Boiler, a pressure tank on a Chem Burner, splits a mixture into all its essences. They flow into jars with matching stickers, but part of every batch is lost to fumes.
quest.hextale.refined_shimmer.desc: Refined Shimmer glows magenta and can be drunk. A vial gives a minute of strength, speed and toughness and leaves a violet vein on my arm. The next sip has to wait.
quest.hextale.shimmer_veins.desc: Each vial leaves a vein, up to five. For about twenty minutes each vein adds a heart and some damage, three give night vision and five give Haste. Then the gifts fade without harm.
quest.hextale.veins_washed.desc: A Bottle of Essence at least half full of light essence washes out one vein when drunk. The Separator draws light essence out of a mixture.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.refined_shimme: the still stands on a lit burner
quest.hextale.pink_brazier.desc: The Pink Brazier burns shimmer in an iron cage on stakes. Its flame sets nothing alight but warms the soil, and plants around it grow faster.
quest.hextale.synthetic_crystal.desc: A Synthetic Crystal grown from Refined Shimmer is weaker than a storm crystal. It still charges the Awakened Workbench and replaces a cut crystal in Void devices until it crumbles.
jei.hextale.info.shimmerbloom: Grows below height 40 in rare violet-lit caves, on floors, walls and ceilings. Bone meal plants a new one beside it.
jei.hextale.info.axolotl_tank: An axolotl fed with fish inside now and then sheds Regenerative Slime through the bottom. A bucket takes it out.
jei.hextale.info.regenerative_slime: Shed by an axolotl in an Axolotl Tank. The catalyst for raw shimmer in the Crucible.
jei.hextale.info.chem_still: A copper still over a lit Chem Burner that refines raw shimmer.
jei.hextale.info.chem_boiler: Splits a mixture into all its essences, each into a nearby jar with its sticker. Its fumes make the land sicker.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_lamppost: Burns light essence to burn off part of the sickness your work causes. Sickness cannot spread into its chunk.
jei.hextale.info.pink_brazier: Burns shimmer vials and now and then grows a few plants within 4 blocks a stage. Refined shimmer lasts twice as long.
jei.hextale.info.synthetic_crystal: Charges workbenches and batteries. In a Purifier or Void Anchor it stands in for a hextech crystal but crumbles sooner.
quest.hextale.lab_bench.desc: Chemtech is studied at the Lab Bench: drops of pure essence react in a flask over a flame. Sealing the flask when it holds what the topic asks for gives Research Notes.
book.hextale.quest.lab_first: Work it out at the Lab Bench first: %s
quest.hextale.growth_tonic.desc: Growth Tonic is a green brew made from bone meal. A vial thrown at the garden makes plants grow, and young animals grow up. Poured onto farmland, it soaks into the soil instead.
quest.hextale.coolant.desc: Coolant is a cold brew made from a snowball. A thrown vial puts out fire, and lava it hits turns to obsidian. It is useful near lava and when a fire spreads.
quest.hextale.glow_mix.desc: Glow Mix, brewed from glowstone dust, glows by itself. A splashed vial leaves patches of cold green light on blocks and makes creatures glow. Handy for caves.
quest.hextale.acid.desc: Acid needs a Chem Burner under the crucible. A thrown vial eats stone, iron, copper and monsters but leaves ore alone. I should try it on an iron block.
lab_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a drop into the flask uses no essence from the jars.
lab_rune.hextale.tempering.desc: Pressure in the flask builds more slowly.
lab_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Reactions in the flask run faster.
lab_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Each finished study gives some experience.
lab_rune.hextale.heat_eater.desc: Sometimes a flask about to burst vents its pressure and stays whole.

gui.hextale.lab_bench.pressure.hint: Gas and searing heat build it; a cool flask lets it go slowly. At 100 the flask bursts.

gui.hextale.lab_bench.say.sample: The topic's sample must lie on the bench
gui.hextale.lab_bench.say.burst: The flask burst - everything in it is lost
jei.hextale.brewing.bottled: One vial per dose, drawn off with glass bottles
jei.hextale.soaking.note: An open drain valve pours essence onto the stone below: every %s mB turns a block into magic stone.
jei.hextale.rune_writing.note: A blank scroll goes into the Rune Circle, the rune is chosen on a stele. It costs the rune's essence.
jei.hextale.splash.rust: Throw the vial at the block. The splash reaches the blocks around it too.
jei.hextale.splash.age: Each splash ages copper one stage.
jei.hextale.splash.lava: Still lava sets into obsidian, flowing lava into cobblestone.
jei.hextale.splash.cool: Throw the vial at the block. It also puts out fire.
jei.hextale.chem_still.note: Over a lit chem burner, %s s per refined vial.
jei.hextale.axolotl_tank.food: Any fish is one meal, a bucket of tropical fish is %s
jei.hextale.axolotl_tank.note: A fed axolotl sheds a lump of slime every %s s and eats one meal for it.
jei.hextale.chem_fuel.essence: Chem Burner: %s s per mB in its tank
jei.hextale.lab_experiment.flask: Drops of essence fall into it from pure jars around the bench
jei.hextale.lab_experiment.sample: Lies on the bench and is sealed into the flask
item.hextale.hextech_skypack.hint: Worn on the chest, it glides like elytra while its tanks hold Air Essence. Taking off from the ground fires the jets.
item.hextale.hextech_skypack.controls: (Jump, then jump again in the air: glide; Shift near jars: refill; right click a jar: refill)
item.hextale.hextech_skypack.no_air: No air essence in this jar
subtitles.hextale.rift_gate.arrive: Something comes out of the rift
subtitles.hextale.rift_gate.break: A rift gate is left alone
skypack_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The jets push harder, so you fly faster.
skypack_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: A strong push forward when the jets ignite at the start of a flight.
skypack_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a take-off uses no air.
skypack_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Less damage from hitting walls and from falling while flying and right after landing.
skypack_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: Gives Fire Resistance while you fly and for a few seconds after landing.
skypack_rune.hextale.flamethrower.desc: While the jets fire, mobs in the flame behind you catch fire. Blocks do not burn.
book.hextale.quest.skypack_rune.note: A Skypack holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_skypack: Put the Skypack in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.

quest.hextale.hextech_skypack.desc: The Skypack carries two tanks of air essence over a pair of nozzles. A second jump in the air fires the jets, then I glide. The tanks refill from Essence Jars.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_skypack: Worn like elytra. With air essence in its tanks, a double jump fires the jets like a firework, then you glide. (Right click a jar with it, or sneak near jars: refill)
quest.hextale.magic_wood.desc: Magic Wood comes from the tree that grows out of a Magic Tree Sprout. The pale wood does not catch fire. I can build a workshop from it without worrying about sparks.
quest.hextale.arcane_cloth.goal: make Arcane Cloth in the crucible
quest.hextale.arcane_cloth.desc: Magic and beast essence in the crucible turn wool into Arcane Cloth. It is heavy and warm, and the essence never washes out. I could sew clothes from it.
quest.hextale.researcher_robe.desc: Arcane Cloth makes a hood, a robe, trousers and boots for my work. Each piece has room for one rune, so I can choose what helps me most.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_banishing.desc: Gives Night Vision in the dark.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_radiance.desc: Experience orbs you pick up give more experience.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_breath.desc: Your air lasts longer under water.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_mending.desc: Slowly repairs all the Researcher's clothes you wear.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_healing.desc: When you take damage, you sometimes get Regeneration.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_fireproofing.d: When fire hurts you, you get Fire Resistance.
clothes_rune.hextale.boots_pollen.desc: While you walk, nearby crops and saplings sometimes grow as with bone meal.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_purification.d: Sometimes removes Poison, Hunger, Weakness, Nausea or Slowness.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_mirror.desc: Sometimes deals damage back to whoever hit you.
clothes_rune.hextale.trousers_shift.desc: You step up onto blocks without jumping.
clothes_rune.hextale.trousers_magnet.des: Pulls dropped items and experience orbs toward you. (Sneak: stop pulling)
clothes_rune.hextale.boots_quenching.des: Reduces damage from magma blocks and other hot floors.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_mirage.desc: Below 40% health after a hit, you turn invisible and mobs lose you until you attack. Then the hood recharges.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_static.desc: Sometimes shocks a close attacker: it takes damage and is slowed for a moment.
clothes_rune.hextale.boots_wavewalk.desc: You can walk on water, with extra speed there, and move more easily under water. (Sneak: sink)

block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the robe holds one rune

jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_boots: Put the Researcher's Boots in the Rune Circle; %s rune.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to the boots
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the boots holds one rune
quest.hextale.rune_chalk.desc: Stabilizing Chalk draws runes on top of solid blocks, and they never smudge. Runes around a Ritual Altar or Rune Circle speed up its rituals, up to ten of them. (Right click the top of a block)
quest.hextale.nullstone.desc: Ash and shadow essence in the crucible turn calcite into grey, heavy Nullstone. It soaks up stray magic and calms a working Hexcore nearby until it fills.
quest.hextale.crystal_battery.desc: The Crystal Battery stores charge from Unstable Hextech or Synthetic Crystals and powers the Awakened Workbenches around it. A comparator reads how full it is.
item.hextale.rune_chalk.hint: Draws rune marks on the floor. Marks around a Ritual Altar or Rune Circle make its rituals faster.
item.hextale.rune_chalk.controls: (Right click the top of a block: draw a rune)
item.hextale.binding_chalk.hint: A closed loop of its lines holds up to six creatures, players only briefly. Fades without Shadow Essence in nearby jars.
item.hextale.binding_chalk.controls: (Right click the top of a block: draw a line)
jei.hextale.info.binding_chalk: A closed loop of its lines holds up to 6 creatures still, players only briefly. It needs shadow essence from jars. (Right click the top of a block: draw)
jei.hextale.info.rune_chalk: Each chalk rune within 4 blocks of a Ritual Altar or Rune Circle speeds up its rituals, up to 10 runes. (Right click the top of a block: draw)
jei.hextale.info.nullstone: Absorbs stray magic: it calms a working Hexcore nearby and draws sickness out of its chunk. Its veins glow as it fills.
jei.hextale.info.crystal_battery: Stores hextech charge and powers Awakened Workbenches within 4 blocks. A comparator reads how full it is. (Right click with a crystal: add. Empty hand: show the charge)
battery_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.des: Charges Awakened Workbenches from farther away.
battery_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a crystal gives 50% more charge.
battery_rune.hextale.sunlight_cell.desc: Under open sky the battery slowly charges itself in daylight. It stops at night and in rain.
book.hextale.quest.battery_rune.note: A Crystal Battery holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_battery: Put the Crystal Battery in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a battery
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the battery holds three runes
block.hextale.hex_foundry.hint: Front of a 3x3x3 Fire Brick kiln that smelts nine stacks at once. (Right click with Hextech Dust once the kiln is built)
block.hextale.hex_foundry.alone: The hatch needs its kiln of fire bricks around it
gui.hextale.hex_foundry.heat.cold: Still waking: nothing melts below the mark
gui.hextale.hex_foundry.heat.hint: The hotter, the faster every piece melts
gui.hextale.hex_foundry.fire.hint: Furnace fuel, or fire and magma essence from jars nearby or pipes
gui.hextale.hex_foundry.nothing_to_melt: Heats only while something melts inside
foundry_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Ores and raw metal sometimes give one extra ingot.
foundry_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes it works without using fuel.
foundry_rune.hextale.smelting.desc: Smelting stone, cobblestone, sand or netherrack sometimes gives an iron, copper or gold nugget.
book.hextale.quest.foundry_rune.note: A Foundry Hatch holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_foundry: Put the Foundry Hatch in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.fire_bricks.desc: Pale Fire Bricks do not crack in a fire. They suit anything that has to stay hot for a long time.
quest.hextale.hex_foundry.goal: build a Foundry and light it
quest.hextale.hex_foundry.desc: A hollow 3x3x3 kiln of Fire Bricks, with iron bars on top and a Foundry Hatch in front, wakes with Hextech Dust. It heats slowly, but then smelts nine stacks at once.
jei.hextale.info.hex_foundry: The front of a hollow 3x3x3 Fire Brick kiln with iron bars on top. Once hot, it smelts nine stacks at once. (Right click the hatch with hextech dust: awaken)
commands.hextale.void.sources: What wore the land thin within %s chunks (%s in all):
commands.hextale.void.sources.none: Nothing has worn the land thin within %s chunks
thinning.hextale.source.spent: Essence spent by rituals and devices
thinning.hextale.source.stilled: Shimmer refined in a Chem Still
thinning.hextale.source.fumes: Fumes of a Chem Boiler's cracking
commands.hextale.void.set: Set the Thinning of %s chunks to %s (%s)
block.hextale.hollowbloom.tooltip: Shows how thin the world around it has become, blooming before the ground shows any sign of the Void.
item.hextale.void_chitin.tooltip: Light, very hard shell dropped by creatures of the Void.
item.hextale.void_pearl.tooltip: A heavy black pearl from a Pearl Sac in the Void. Used to make the Riftforged Bulwark Cuirass.
quest.hextale.void_chitin.desc: Creatures from the breach drop pieces of their shells. Void Chitin is hard as stone and light as bone. I should study it under the loupe, maybe it can become armour.
quest.hextale.the_thinning.desc: A lilac haze lies over the grass and dark specks sink into the ground. It most likely comes from the essence I boil, brew and spill. I can clean the land or let it grow and watch.
quest.hextale.hollowbloom.desc: Hextech Dust turns a dead bush into a Hollowbloom. It blooms as the world thins, before the ground shows any sign. I will plant one by the door and check it now and then.
quest.hextale.let_it_spread: What If I Let It Be?
quest.hextale.let_it_spread.desc: Instead of cleaning the land, I could keep working and let the haze grow. Every drop of essence I boil, brew or spill feeds it. I want to see what it becomes.
quest.hextale.void_blight.goal: find land the Void has taken
quest.hextale.void_blight.desc: The land here is sick. Grass turns grey, the soil becomes black Void Soil and stone turns into violet Void Rock. Plants either die or turn into strange new growths worth studying.
quest.hextale.void_flora.goal: study a Void plant under the loupe
quest.hextale.void_flora.desc: Void Coral, Void Roots and Void Bulbs grow only on sick ground. Nobody planted them, they appear as the land gets sicker. I should study one under the loupe.
quest.hextale.void_mites.desc: Small cold creatures latch onto me. While they hang on, I have fewer hearts. Only a potion of healing makes them let go.
quest.hextale.void_breach.desc: The ground shook and tore open into a breach. Creatures crawl out, and touching it hurts and throws me back. It will not close by itself: I must hold it or heal the land around.
quest.hextale.void_chitin.goal: study Void Chitin under the loupe
jei.hextale.info.hollowbloom: Dry twigs on clean land, a glowing flower near the Void. A comparator beside it reads its state. (Right click a dead bush with hextech dust)
jei.hextale.info.void_chitin: Dropped by creatures of the Void. It is used to make Void Carapace in the Crucible.
subtitles.hextale.voidling.emerge: Something pushes out of the Void
hextale.configuration.breachCinematic.to: Fly the camera to a breach of the Void that tears open nearby.
hextale.configuration.runeSigns.tooltip: Which rune signs are drawn when a rune works: all, all but your own, or none (runes still glint).
block.hextale.hextech_purifier.hint: Draws sickness from the land into its crystal, which clouds over as it fills. Burns Light Essence from nearby jars.
block.hextale.hextech_purifier.status: Draws on %sx%s chunks; the crystal is %s%% clouded
block.hextale.hextech_purifier.status.em: No crystal: put a hextech or synthetic crystal in
block.hextale.hextech_purifier.status.cl: The crystal is clouded through: take it out
block.hextale.hextech_lamppost.status.da: Dark: it needs light essence in a jar nearby
block.hextale.hextech_lamppost.status.li: Lit: %s blocks around, burns off %s%%, light left for %s mB
block.hextale.hextech_purifier.status.un: No light essence in the jars nearby
block.hextale.hextech_purifier.status.cl: The land within %sx%s chunks is well
item.hextale.clouded_crystal.tooltip: A crystal full of sickness. Used on an anchor of a held breach, it folds the breach into a Breach Heart. (Shift + right click on the anchor)
purifier_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The purifier draws sickness from chunks farther away.
purifier_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The purifier draws sickness out of the land more often.
purifier_rune.hextale.purification.desc: The crystal holds more sickness before it clouds over.
purifier_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Land it draws on sometimes grows grass and flowers as it heals.
purifier_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes drawing sickness out of the land costs no light essence.
book.hextale.quest.purifier_rune.note: A Crystal Purifier holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_purifier: Put the Crystal Purifier in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a purifier
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the purifier holds three runes
jei.hextale.info.hextech_purifier: Burns light essence to draw sickness out of the land into its crystal. A hopper below can take out a clouded crystal. (Crystal in hand: put it in. Empty hand: take it out)
jei.hextale.info.clouded_crystal: A crystal filled in a Purifier or Void Anchor. On an anchor of a held breach, it folds the breach into a Breach Heart. (Shift + right click the anchor)
quest.hextale.cleanse_land.desc: On sick land, Nullstone draws the sickness out of the ground and its pores fill with violet. A few stones around the workshop keep the haze down, but lost land needs more.
quest.hextale.hextech_purifier.desc: A crystal over a font of clear water draws the sickness out of the land around it. It clouds over as it fills, and the purifier burns light essence. (Right click with a crystal: set it, with an empty hand: take it out)
quest.hextale.hextech_lamppost.desc: In the Lamppost's light, part of the sickness from my work burns away before it settles. Sickness from nearby land cannot creep in. It burns light essence.
quest.hextale.clouded_crystal.desc: A crystal that has filled with the Void comes out dark and heavy. It keeps what it took in, so throwing it away would be a waste. It may be useful near a held breach.
quest.hextale.healed_land.desc: Where the sickness is drawn out, the black soil turns back into earth and the glassy growths wither. The grass gets its colour back too.
quest.hextale.breach_fades.desc: A breach feeds on sick land. When enough land around it is healed, it starves, shrinks and closes. This only works while nothing holds it open, such as a Void Anchor.
block.hextale.void_anchor.hint: Holds one side of a nearby breach while a crystal hangs in it. Six anchors, one on each side of a breach, hold it still.
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.empty: No crystal: put a hextech or synthetic crystal in
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.clouded: The crystal is clouded through: swap it
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.free: No breach within reach; the crystal is %s%% clouded
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.held: Holds the breach; the crystal is %s%% clouded
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.fightin: The breach fights back - the ring is not closed; the crystal is %s%% clouded
anchor_rune.hextale.dam.desc: The crystal clouds more slowly while the anchor holds a breach.
anchor_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning from the crystal hits Voidlings and Void Mites near the anchor.
anchor_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: Voidlings and Void Mites near the anchor are slowed and glow.
book.hextale.quest.anchor_rune.note: A Void Anchor holds up to %s runes.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_anchor: Put the Void Anchor in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to an anchor
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the anchor holds two runes
jei.hextale.info.void_anchor: Six anchors, one per side, hold a breach. It then eats unknown essence from their jars and draws sickness from the land.
quest.hextale.void_anchor.desc: A nullstone standing stone with a crystal in its window. Near a breach it ties a thread of light to the nearest edge. Until the ring closes, more creatures come, so ring it fully. (Right click with a crystal: set it, with an empty hand: take it out)
quest.hextale.subdued_breach.goal: hold a breach with anchors on every side
quest.hextale.subdued_breach.desc: With six anchors the ring closes and the breach cools to violet. Nothing crawls out, and the land stops getting sicker. Crystals now wear only when it eats or is passed through.
quest.hextale.void_maw.desc: The Maw eats magic. Leftovers from the jars by the anchors run into it along the threads, and the land around slowly gets cleaner. Items thrown in vanish too.
quest.hextale.void_incubator.goal: see a fed breach give birth
quest.hextale.void_incubator.desc: A held breach that is fed enough pushes out a voidling, one at a time. After a big meal the newborn comes out already grown. Its shell is useful, but it is still a hunter.
quest.hextale.kept_breach.goal: keep a held breach on healed land
quest.hextale.kept_breach.desc: First I hold the breach, then I heal the land around it. The soil is clean again, and the breach stays quiet in the middle of it. Now I have a piece of the Void right next to home.
quest.hextale.voidling_growth.desc: This voidling by the breach is bigger than the first. They grow by feeding at the breach and on their kills, shedding shells as they go. Better to deal with them while small.
item.hextale.breach_heart.tooltip: A whole breach folded to the size of a fist. It slows down whoever carries it.
item.hextale.breach_heart.controls: (Right click the ground: unfold the breach there. Left lying on the ground, it unfolds by itself after half a minute)
item.hextale.breach_heart.needs_ground: It needs firm ground under it
item.hextale.breach_heart.no_room: There is no room for it to open here
block.hextale.void_anchor.fold.not_held: This anchor holds nothing that could be folded
jei.hextale.info.breach_heart: A folded breach. It slows whoever carries it and unfolds on the ground into the same breach, wild again.
quest.hextale.breach_heart.goal: fold a held breach: sneak and press a Clouded Crystal to one of its anchors
quest.hextale.breach_heart.desc: Pressing a Clouded Crystal to an anchor folds the whole held breach into a heart the size of my hand. It beats, and carrying it slows me down. It can open again elsewhere. (Shift + right click an anchor)
quest.hextale.breach_moved.desc: The heart unfolds into the same breach, with the same shape. The old place is quiet, but here the breach is wild again until six anchors hold it.
block.hextale.worn_void_membrane.tooltip: Tears a moment after you step on it, and the tear spreads through worn membrane nearby. Grows back over time.
item.hextale.raw_riftmetal.tooltip: Mined from Riftmetal Ore in the Void. It cannot be smelted alone, only alloyed in the Awakened Furnace.
item.hextale.hollow_crystal.tooltip: Hextech emptied by the Void. In a Crystal Purifier or Void Anchor it lasts four times as long as a Hextech Crystal.
jei.hextale.info.hollow_crystal: Found in the Void. In a Crystal Purifier or Void Anchor it replaces a hextech crystal and lasts four times as long.
quest.hextale.step_through.desc: With the ring around it, the breach no longer pushes me back. On the other side there is no ground, only huge bones with skin stretched between them. The way home stays open.
quest.hextale.rift_ore.goal: break Raw Riftmetal out of a vein
quest.hextale.rift_ore.desc: Black metal grows into the chitin here, in veins that sparkle violet in the dark. There is more of it further from the edge. Only a pickaxe as strong as netherite can break it.
quest.hextale.sinew_willow.goal: cut wood from a Sinew Willow
quest.hextale.sinew_willow.desc: These are the Void's trees: trunks braided from sinews, long fronds and glowing pods. The wood works like any other, and an Ichor Pod lets me see in the dark for a while.
quest.hextale.the_undertow.goal: ride a current of the Void
quest.hextale.the_undertow.desc: Streams of pale air arc between plates over the gaps and carry me across. Some fade now and then, and their whistle drops just before. I should be over solid ground by then.
quest.hextale.thin_floors.goal: have the Void's floor give way under you
quest.hextale.thin_floors.desc: Pale skin and pale chitin look like the floor, only a shade lighter, and both can give way. The crust ticks and the skin stretches first. I should listen and keep moving.
quest.hextale.rib_crawler.goal: have a Rib Crawler drop on you
quest.hextale.rib_crawler.desc: Dry clicking under a rib above me, then a long creature of plates and legs drops beside me. Rib Crawlers hang under the ribs and wait. Now I look up when I hear clicking.
quest.hextale.pit_maw.desc: A low bump ringed with short spines opens when stepped on. Its pull is strong, but running breaks free and a hit makes it close. These bumps are better walked around.
quest.hextale.the_seer.desc: An eye in a cage of petals drifts in the air. Its violet thread on my chest calls every Void creature nearby to me. It keeps its distance, so it is best killed fast.
quest.hextale.nursery.desc: The nursery is a hall-sized husk with one way in. Sacs line the walls, and what is curled inside hatches when I come near. Smaller sacs on the central mound hold something dark.
quest.hextale.void_pearl.desc: A Void Pearl is black, smooth and heavy for its size. It lies in the small sacs on the mound, but some sacs burst into mites. It could be the heart of my strongest armour.
quest.hextale.swallowed_ruin.goal: open a chest in the swallowed ruins
quest.hextale.swallowed_ruin.desc: On top of the swallowed stone stands the gnawed corner of a house of planks and cobblestone. Someone lived here before the Void took this piece of our world. A chest survived.
quest.hextale.hollow_crystal.desc: Grey, empty crystals cut like hextech grow on the gnawed stone of the shoals. The Void drained them, so in a Purifier or Void Anchor they last far longer than hextech.
quest.hextale.void_glass.goal: make Void Glass at the Hex Workbench
quest.hextale.void_glass.desc: Lilac Void Glass from the Awakened Workbench still shows the net of the membrane, and light passes through it.
quest.hextale.void_lens.goal: make a Void Lens at the Hex Workbench
quest.hextale.void_lens.desc: A spyglass with a Hollow Crystal for a lens soaks up the haze, so I see much further in the Void. Riftmetal ore, hollow crystals and thin floors show from far away.
entity.hextale.the_void.ring_closed: The ring is closed: the breach is held
block.hextale.husk_crust.tooltip: Thin chitin over a hollow that cracks and gives way if you stand on it. Grows back over time.
block.hextale.spore_puff.tooltip: Bursts when you walk into it and slows your fall for a few seconds, then grows back. A picked one works when crushed. (Right click: crush)
block.hextale.spring_blister.tooltip: Throws you about eight blocks up when you step on it. Falling onto it does no damage. (Sneak: step on it without being thrown)
block.hextale.sinew_curtain.tooltip: Sticky strands that slow down anyone pushing through and snap after a while. Creatures of the Void pass freely.
block.hextale.void_tendrils.tooltip: Hangs from the underside of blocks and glows at the tip. It can be climbed like a vine.
item.hextale.void_ichor_bucket.tooltip: Thick glowing fluid from the Void. Burns in a furnace as long as a bucket of lava.
block.hextale.garden.other_dose: It already holds %s - one kind at a time
block.hextale.chem_planter.empty: The tank is dry: pour in growth tonic, raw shimmer or sap
block.hextale.sap_tap.dry: No sap: the trunk is not part of a living tree
block.hextale.sap_tap.status: Sap in the spout: %s of %s mB
planter_rune.hextale.growth.desc: The planter feeds its plant more often.
planter_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: A ripe plant harvested from the planter sometimes drops its harvest twice.
planter_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: When the planter feeds its plant, a plant next to it sometimes grows a stage too.
planter_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes feeding the plant uses no dose.
sprinkler_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a dose sprayed on a bed costs nothing.
sprinkler_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: A plant that gets a dose from the spray sometimes grows a stage at once.
tap_rune.hextale.spring.desc: Sometimes a drop comes out twice as big.
book.hextale.quest.planter_rune.note: A Chem Planter holds up to %s runes.
book.hextale.quest.sprinkler_rune.note: An Essence Sprinkler holds up to %s runes.
book.hextale.quest.tap_rune.note: A Sap Tap holds up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.sap_tap.desc: The Sap Tap on a living trunk drips sap essence into a jar or pipe below. Without one it keeps the sap for a glass bottle. Magic and jungle trees give more, dead logs none.
quest.hextale.steeped_soil.desc: Steeped Soil is farmland soaked with Growth Tonic, raw shimmer or sap essence. It never dries out or gets trampled, and crops on it grow faster and sometimes yield double. (Right click farmland with a vial)
quest.hextale.chem_planter.desc: The Chem Planter is a glass-sided iron box: a plant on top, brew in the tank below. Each dose grows the plant a stage, day or night. It fills from vials, a bottle of sap or a pipe.
quest.hextale.essence_sprinkler.desc: The Essence Sprinkler's turning head waters the farmland around it. It also tops up steeped soil and Chem Planters nearby with the brew poured into it or with piped sap.
jei.hextale.info.steeped_soil: Soaked farmland that never dries or gets trampled. While doses last, crops grow faster and sometimes yield double.
jei.hextale.info.chem_planter: Grows its plant stage by stage on doses from its tank, day or night. Fed by vials, sap essence or an Essence Sprinkler.
jei.hextale.info.essence_sprinkler: Waters farmland within 3 blocks and tops up soaked beds and planters with its brew or piped sap essence.
jei.hextale.info.sap_tap: Drips sap from a living trunk into a jar or pipe below, or saves it for a bottle. Magic and jungle trees give more.
sprinkler_rune.hextale.healing.desc: Players in the spray get Regeneration.
tap_rune.hextale.photosynthesis.desc: In daylight under open sky, the tree sometimes gives an extra drop.
quest.hextale.strain_shimmer_bulb.goal: turn glow berries into Shimmer Bulbs in the crucible
quest.hextale.strain_shimmer_bulb.desc: Rift and sap essence in the crucible turn glow berries into Shimmer Bulbs. On farmland they grow into violet Cultivated Shimmerblooms.
quest.hextale.transmutation.desc: Magma essence in the crucible turns sand into red sand. Flowers, logs, mushrooms and fish change the same way, and all of it works both ways.
quest.hextale.advanced_transmutation.des: Stronger essences let the crucible change rarer things too: redstone into glowstone dust, crimson plants into warped ones, and back.
quest.hextale.strain_ember_wheat.goal: turn wheat seeds into Ember Wheat in the crucible
quest.hextale.strain_ember_wheat.desc: Magma and plant essence in the crucible turn wheat seeds into Ember Wheat Seeds. The ripe wheat burns as furnace fuel and dissolves into magma essence.
quest.hextale.strain_sap_gourd.goal: turn melon seeds into a Sap Gourd in the crucible
quest.hextale.strain_sap_gourd.desc: Sap and plant essence in the crucible turn melon seeds into Sap Gourd Seeds. They grow like melons, and the gourd is full of sap essence for the crucible.
quest.hextale.strain_crystal_cane.goal: turn sugar cane into Crystal Cane in the crucible
quest.hextale.strain_crystal_cane.desc: Crystal and water essence in the crucible turn sugar cane into Crystal Cane. Now and then it grows clear pods of crystal essence on its joints. (Right click: pick the pods)
jei.hextale.info.crystal_cane: Now and then grows clear Crystal Pods on its joints, faster on Steeped Soil. (Right click: pick the pods)
jei.hextale.info.sap_gourd_seeds: Grow a stem like melon seeds, and the Sap Gourds beside it are full of sap essence.
lab_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: A plant studied cleanly sometimes gives a second cutting.
brew.hextale.ember_oil.use: Fuel for the Chem Burner and for furnaces. Burns half as long again as Combustible Mix.
quest.hextale.ember_oil.desc: Ember Wheat boils down into a thick amber oil. It burns longer than the combustible mix, and later it will be the plainest fuel for gear that runs on a tank.
block.hextale.chem_still.status.no_pod: No Crystal Pod: the shimmer will not clear without one
block.hextale.chem_vat.alone: Build it into the front of a Chem Vat and seal the vat with a vial of acid
block.hextale.chem_vat.full: No room in the vat for that
block.hextale.chem_vat.status.idle: Bath: acid %s, shimmer %s. Drop in metal to temper
block.hextale.chem_vat.status.full: The valve is full: take the tempered metal
block.hextale.chem_vat.status.cold: Cold: give the fire a vial of fuel
quest.hextale.chem_vat.desc: A tank of rusted plating over a Chem Burner, sealed with a vial of acid. Its bath of acid and refined shimmer tempers metal over a fire of fuel vials.
quest.hextale.chem_steel.desc: Iron and netherite scrap tempered in the vat's bath come out as chem-steel, the metal for gear that runs on a tank.
jei.hextale.info.chem_vat: Tempers metal in a bath of acid and refined shimmer over a fire of fuel vials. Things thrown on its grate fall in.
block.hextale.chem_tank.other_fuel: The tank holds %s: one fuel at a time
block.hextale.chem_tank.cannot_pump: Your tank is full or holds another fuel
quest.hextale.chem_tank.desc: A glass fuel tank worn on the back. It holds one fuel at a time and will feed gear that runs on it. Set down, it is filled with vials and tops up the tank I wear.
jei.hextale.info.chem_tank: Worn on the back or in a Curios back slot. Set down, it takes fuel vials and an empty hand pumps it into the worn tank.
item.hextale.chem_gear.empty: No fuel on your back: barely works
quest.hextale.chem_tools.desc: Tools that never break and take no runes. They are as strong as the fuel in the tank on my back: refined shimmer gives the most, and with an empty tank they barely work.
quest.hextale.chem_armour.goal: make a piece of chem-steel armour
quest.hextale.chem_armour.desc: Armour that never breaks and takes no runes. It guards as well as the fuel in my tank allows, and every blow it takes burns a little of it.
quest.hextale.tank_chestplate.goal: make a chestplate with a built-in tank
quest.hextale.tank_chestplate.desc: A chem-steel chestplate with the tank built into its back: armour and fuel in one piece. It fills and pumps like a Chem Tank.
